"My boyfriend surely is a great capitalist!" Nyx laughed merrily while kissing his cheeks repeatedly.
One of the best things about the media platform was that people couldn't pirate or share access with others.
While people could materialize their status windows for others to see if they wished, the same was not true for any other portion of the awakened platform.
As a result, no recording software could capture it, and no one else could gain access to the content one paid for.

I have many mouths to feed, after all," his jesting was received by Nyx slyly murmuring, "You're feeding us alright...

It wasn't that difficult, I bought everything from a second-hand store for cheap, ordered the demonic decorations online, and put them together according to the guide.
Did you like it?"
"You sly woman, always fishing for my compliments...
Have you no shame?"
"I got caught, hehe!
Please don't punish me, master...!" She begged while nuzzling her head into his shoulder affectionately.
Kaiden didn't know what to do with this woman.
He thought Nyx was the least into him out of the trio, but if this wasn't a girl in love, then who was?
"Wanna watch it together?"
She stopped rubbing her face into him and looked up at Kaiden with surprise.
"You already edited it?
While we were talking?"
"Yeah.
Women being better multitaskers than men is a complete lie, I'm not surprised at your disbelief."
"Hey!
I'm great at it as well."
"Really?
Then why don't you showcase it by giving me a handy while we simultaneously watch the video?
That would prove me wrong."

The Space Valkyrie positioned herself to sit properly in his lap with his shaft resting between her thighs as if it were a joystick while opening her media platform.

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Awakened Tiers
paragraphs: "I'm so excited!" Nyx squealed at the back of the taxi. "Maybe we will meet Scarlet there if we're really lucky!"
Even though she was an awakened now, the pink-haired beauty still looked up to the Ruler of the Flames as her idol. Scarlet had a distinguished career; she was very popular.
"What would she be doing at the registration?" Aria asked a very good question.
"Ugh... I don't know, maybe she got called to talk with the association chairman but got lost and ended up at the registration center."

"Keep coping, space bimbo. You'd already seen a woman of her caliber anyhow." Luna's words didn't leave the desired effect in Nyx. She was right in that Vespera was on the same level as a combatant and in the fame department as well, but they couldn't be further apart regarding their personalities. Scarlet was a charismatic, fiery person who inspired confidence in her fellow awakened and made them dream big, while Vespera was like a cold murder machine of the highest order.

"We'll meet her once we become strong enough, Nyx," Kaiden decreed confidently. If they were to reach Scarlet and Vespera's level of strength, they would be called upon to team up with fellow powerful awakened to clear out the greatest dungeons that threaten the peace of the United States.

When a dungeon wasn't cleared in time, the monsters in the separate dimension could cross over to Earth. It was the Awakened Association's job to administer and guard every single dungeon, but they had the right to mobilize awakened even if they were not associated. It was rare for them to do as such because no one looked favorably upon being forcibly conscripted, but it did happen from time to time.

Both Vespera and Scarlet were associated with the government, so they were called upon much more often than non-associated awakened were. In exchange, they enjoyed many privileges, such as having insider information and the full backing of the state.

"You're right," Nyx nodded happily. She had to admit that there was no need to rush. The Space Valkyrie would also be happier if she could meet Scarlet as an accomplished fellow awakened and not as a mere fangirl.

The Awakened Association had branches in all the major cities, so they only needed to travel for thirty minutes. Once their ride stopped and they stepped out, the awe-inspiring sight of the branch building welcomed them.

Every association building was made with materials harvested from beyond the gates and put together with the assistance of crafter-classed individuals. Doing so ensured their buildings were protected from most attacks by monsters and awakened. Human-made explosives would not dent such materials at all, the association was not worried about normal weapons, for those were a thing of the past.

Kaiden glanced toward the branch, which resembled a fortress more than an organization's administrative building. It might've been built like a fortress, but a trendy, modern touch made it strangely fit in with the 21st-century architecture standards. Its walls were made from a metal brought from beyond the gates; it was a smooth and glossy black.

The entrance was massive, with towering pillars on each side, and each pillar had carvings of creatures locked in battle with awakened humans. The symbol of the Awakened Association shone above the doorway: a fiery red phoenix with its wings spread wide.
There were multiple such entrances, each leading to a different department of the association. Kaiden and his Sinsworn Valkyries walked toward the one that dealt with the registration process.

In front of this specific entrance, dozens of paparazzi—journalists, if we were being generous—stood ready to snap pictures and film videos. The birth of a new high-tier awakened was the story they were fishing for. Such news would result in numerous clicks.

As for the ranks of classes, they went as such: F-tiers were trash non-combatants most of the time, like the gardener girl with the bubbly butt. They faced way too many obstacles, such as upon leveling up, they received worse gains than higher tiers did.

When one reaches the first bottleneck at level 25 and shoots past it, their rewards heavily depend on their tier. An F-tier might only gain a single spell which could be similarly shitty as their original one(s), while higher tiers might receive numerous strong spells.
E and D tiers were the footsoldiers in any competitive guilds. They were usually just strong enough to justify their inclusion in secondary parties.
C and B tiers were the standard awakened that any guild happily welcomed in their midst. They had bright futures but were overshadowed by the rarer tiers.

A-tiers were often the cream of the crop. Not many of them existed, and the birth of an A-tier awakened was what these journalists were here for. Most, if not all of the mid-tier guilds were led by A-tier awakened because they were the final 'standard' tier.

S-tiers were extremely rare. They were thought to be above the standard tiers because the rewards they gained for breaking through bottlenecks were beyond what even A-tiers could hope for. Governments across the globe would do almost anything to get an S-tier awakened to join them.

The mythical tier above that of the S-tier was not an official one. S-tier was the highest rank the Awakened Association awarded, but some people speculated those with hidden tiers, such as Vespera and Scarlet, might be beyond the S rank.
"Hey! Can I get a few words?" a man with a camera in his hands shouted toward Kaiden and his group.

"Sure," Kaiden nodded and walked up to him. He was a bit confused about his mission, 'Spark of Interest,' which was to gain popularity by utilizing this occasion. Perhaps getting featured in a newspaper could help, he thought.
The man placed his camera on a tripod and started filming.
"What's your name?"
"Kaiden."
"Kaiden, nice to meet you. I'm Rupert from AwaNews. Can you tell me about how you found out you awakened?"
"I just woke up and felt different." People typically awakened while they were asleep, so he went with the traditional answer, even if it was a lie.
"I see. What tier do you expect yourself to end up with?"

"Probably F-tier, to be honest," he said while smiling awkwardly. He thought his class was way too nerfed by the system at the moment to be anything beyond the worst tier. Its spells were promising since he knew they would be upgraded with each bottleneck he broke through, as opposed to how it was for normal awakened whose spells didn't get stronger after reaching level 25. They merely gained new spells, which for Kaiden and the girls would happen upon ranking his Demonic Pornstar System up, not breaking bottlenecks.
For now, his spells were very rudimentary.

Rupert's features immediately changed upon hearing his answer. F-tiers were horrible news material. No one cared to read about them. "Thanks for your time," he spat coldly while not even reaching his right arm out for a handshake.
Kaiden expected a disheartened reply but not to be outright dismissed like this. "Come, Kai, let's go," Aria's soft voice entered his ears while she grabbed his hand and squeezed supportively.
"You're right. No need to waste our time," Kaiden nodded and turned toward the entrance.

It was only now that Rupert noticed the three bombshells who were accompanying him. "Wait! Can you tell me about your relationship with these women?" he shouted after Kaiden, but he didn't care to respond.
The reporter then turned his head toward the last two women and gulped heavily when he saw the furious glares both were eyeing him with.
"Rupert from AwaNews, right? I'll make sure never to forget." The shorter, purple-haired girl decreed in a similarly cold tone with which he dismissed the young man beforehand.

"Did no one ever tell you to look beyond what's visible on the surface?" the pink-haired girl asked, but she didn't wait for his answer. After turning their backs on him, the duo quickly followed Kaiden and Aria.
Rupert didn't understand why he was so intimidated by their glares. He couldn't help but feel he just missed out on a big news story, but he couldn't explain why. Wasn't an F rank just a nobody?

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Shocking Findings
paragraphs: "Welcome! Are you here to register?" a woman in an elegant uniform greeted them inside the building.
"Yes."
Seeing there were four of them, the woman spoke up, "Friends and family are asked to wait outside. A legal guardian may be present in the case of an underaged awakened's registration."
"They are also awakened. We're here to register together," Kaiden replied in a patient, accommodating tone.

"Oh!" the attendant exclaimed in surprise. Four acquaintances awakened within a week from each other? That was certainly a rare occurrence. "My apologies," she bowed before continuing, "There's a short queue ahead. You're the third in line. Please wait here for you to be called. Can I bring you some refreshments in the meantime?"

Awakened were the new gems of any nation, thus, any sensible government tried their best to treat them well. A simple gesture like bringing them a glass of water could make the awakened look favorably at the association, which would help the organization recruit the youths they find worthy.
"That would be great, thank you."
They sat down together in the waiting room and chatted until they were called upon by the same woman who brought them the glasses of water.
"Please give me your identifications."
Once that was sorted, she nodded and continued, "Thank you. Follow me, please."
They were led into a large room where three additional staff awaited them. Two seemed to be guards, while the final one was an older man with round glasses and a black tablet in his hand.

The receptionist handed him their identifications, and he entered them into the system through the tablet. "Hmm... Not siblings, you don't even have a common background such as going to the same high school. May I know how you came to know each other?" His question made all three women's cheeks redden, knowing their lover would be blunt about it.
"We starred in an adult film together."
'Yep, just like that...'each girl sighed inwardly.

"Hoh?!" the man's ears perked from excitement. He didn't care in the least that they were pornstars. Instead, it was the circumstances that made his heart begin to beat faster. "And you each awakened afterward?! How is that possible?! Wait, two of you are even twenty or older! The statistical odds of this happening are almost exactly zero!"

This was the exact reason why Kaiden debated about having each of them register at different points in time and possibly even locations, but he knew when the girls' class names were read, they would end up being associated anyway. They all had the word 'Valkyrie' in their classes, after all. Perhaps he would escape the association's scrutiny, but he didn't want to leave the three of them to deal with this without him being there for them.

Kaiden shrugged his shoulders, "Stranger things have happened since the apocalypse, no?" he did his best to lessen the 'wow' factor of their awakening. The last thing he wanted right now was to be imprisoned in some secret government facility to be researched at great lengths. Naturally, the government denied the existence of any such facility, but he found their words to be hard to trust.
"Hmm... You might be right, but still. You didn't feel anything special? Not even the slightest things were out of the ordinary?"

"We made great love to each other, maybe that was the secret sauce," he said while shrugging his shoulders, eliciting a bulging vein on the old man's forehead and even redder cheeks on his ladies' gorgeous faces.

"... Let's move on then..." The scientist studying the apocalypse and its effects on humans in particular grumbled. He gestured at an orb, "You probably know how this goes, right? Put your palm on the artifact and keep it there until I tell you to lift it. It will show your class, and the light it emits will let us know of your class' tier."

No artifact could outright classify people into tiers; nothing stated that the gardener girl with the bubbly butt was F-tier. It just displayed her class' name and emitted a faint light, signaling it was weak, at which point the association categorized her to be an F-tier awakened. There were some debates about whether this method was trustworthy enough to group awakened into tiers, but that was just the opinion of a small minority. This artifact has been very accurate thus far.

Kaiden went first. "Paragon of Sin..." The man grumbled as the words formed on the orb. In a few seconds, it began emitting a faint, weak light. "F... tier?" the glassed man asked with disbelief. It was very rare to have such a badass-sounding class be this weak. No class was named 'Shadowblade, Phantom Striker, Cursed Specter' and was an F-tier. Multiple studies found a strong correlation between a class' strength and how badass its name sounded.
"What are your spells?!" he shouted at Kaiden, but the young man once again shrugged his shoulders dismissively while saying, "I have no wishes to disclose that information at this moment in time."
Indeed, the artifact couldn't display what spells were available to the awakened.
Another vein bulged on the old man's forehead, but he was restricted by the annoying laws of the USA, so his hands were tied.
"Ladies, if you will," he gestured for them to replicate Kaiden's motions, and each time they did, his face became paler and paler.
"Space Valkyrie... F-tier...?"
"S-Storm V-Valkyrie?! F-tier???"
"M-M-M-Moon V-V-V-Valkyirie!!! F-F-F-F-F-F-tier!!!"

By the time Aria's turn came, he was screaming from the top of his lungs in complete disbelief. There was no way this was some random occurrence! He had to study this phenomenon in great detail! Just as the scientist thought that his tablet rang. He was receiving a call from the higher-ups.
"Curses! The timing... You two, keep them here! They're not allowed to leave!" he shouted at the guards and then rushed to another room to receive the call.

The old man's eyes nearly bulged out of their sockets when the famous visage of the chairman's secretary welcomed him. There was not a lot of information available about this woman, but everyone who knew her recognized her astounding levels of professionalism and complete loyalty to the chairman and the government. "Dr. Eckbert," she greeted him.
"Lady Grace! Good timing, I just stumbled upon four truly rare specimens! We must transfer them to 'the lab' for further study!"
"Dr. Eckbert, you're to complete their registration and release them at once." The tone of Grace's declaration made it clear she wasn't asking his opinion on the matter.
"B-but Lady Grace! This might be the breakthrough my research needs-"

"Complete their registration and release them. You're forbidden from harming any of them in any shape or form, not now nor at any time in the future. If you do so, you will be treated as a terrorist who is a great threat toward the continued peace and prosperity of the United States of America," she interjected in an authoritative tone.
Eckbert couldn't believe his ears. "Why?! Just why?!" he shouted his question unprofessionally. The doctor couldn't care about decorum right now.
"We received a visit from Vespera Ashborn not long ago."

Hearing that name, the doctor trembled from head to toe involuntarily because the few times he met the woman, she didn't leave averywarm impression on him, but he still didn't understand why that mattered. Seeing his confused state of mind, Grace continued, "There was some family drama, Kaiden Grey is her full-blooded son—and the clear favorite one at that by the look of things—but she disowned him for some reason we're still trying to understand. This is a secret; you may not disclose it to anyone. Anyhow..."
Grace had a wry expression as she finished her statement.
"Vespera Ashborn promised the chairman should we do anything to Kaiden or his allies, she would declare war on the United States of America and leave the country to join the CCP."

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Registration Complete!
paragraphs: "Your registration is complete... You will receive your special awakened identification cards in a day or so..." the old scientist muttered with a ghostly pale face. Kaiden and the girls didn't understand why he acted as if he'd just seen the end of the world, but they were happy to be let go without getting hard-to-answer questions thrown at them.

"Yessssss!!! We're officially awakened!" As soon as they left the room with the artifact, Nyx squealed with overwhelming joy and ran up to Kaiden. His back was turned toward her, but that didn't deter the pink-haired beauty at all as, in the next moment, she jumped onto his back and began laying numerous kisses on the back of his head.
Kaiden was surprised but managed to grab her lower thighs, supporting her weight.

"We're in public..." Aria whispered bashfully while watching the surroundings. The exit they left the room through led them back to the reception area, so numerous staff and awaiting registrees stared at Nyx's antics.
"I don't care! My submissive roleplay porn is already on the net; my image cannot be ruined any further!" The Space Valkyrie decreed merrily, not at all bothered by what she was saying.

"Khm! Khm! May I ask where that can be found?" A guy coughed into his palm before asking his question. He immediately received a very strong elbow into his side from the girl sitting next to him. She was looking at him with complete disbelief in her furious eyes.
"Valhalla's Sinners!" Nyx replied without an ounce of shame or care, after which she went back to needily hugging her boyfriend and kissing him fervently.
"And you said I made you feel like an innocent maiden...?" Luna grumbled, referencing her earlier words.
"That was before my inhibitions have been removed. I've found my peace with my place in the world; I couldn't care less what randoms think of me!"
"Didn't you blush a few minutes ago when Kaiden said we met during a porn shoot to the scientist dude?"
Luna's question was met with a sly giggle, "Hehe! My inhibitions were removed after that when we became official awakened!"
"That's the spirit," Kaiden agreed while laughing heartily.
The two women kept bickering while Aria tried to get them to make up. When they stepped out of the building, a chorus of frenzied screams welcomed them.
"A-tier!!"
"I can't believe this!"
"Can you tell us about your thoughts?!"

Dozens of reporters were in the middle of losing their marbles while taking thousands of pictures per second of the young man standing in front of them. He'd just finished his evaluation and gotten the fabled A-tier classification.
"Ahaha! If you want to hear from me, then you gotta schedule an appointment with my agent once I hire one!" he shouted gleefully, looking very full of himself.

Kaiden put Nyx down from his back and murmured with disbelief, "... David?" He recognized the man to be his dorm neighbor, the guy he'd been beefing with ever since breaking his little toy in kindergarten.
"Huh?" The man in question somehow heard his voice and turned around. He was just as surprised. "Kaiden? What are you doing here?"
"I awakened. I see you did as well. Congratulations."
"Hehehe! Yeah, I'm of the amazing A-class, can you believe it? What tier did you get?"
"N-no way! Ahahaha!" David began mockingly laughing at him from the top of his lungs, so much so that he had to clutch his stomach while doing so.
Kaiden wasn't overly bothered. In his eyes, David was the perfect example of an eternal loser, no matter what he managed to achieve.
"Where did you leave Becky?" Kaiden asked, he couldn't see her anywhere nearby. She surely should've come with her partner for such a monumental event.

David continued laughing for a few seconds until he finally managed to hold it together long enough to reply. It was evident to all observers he was having the greatest time of his life. "The first thing I did once I noticed my awakening was break up with her. She was nothing but a mistake I made in my youthful desperation."
"What a wonderful boyfriend you are," Luna scoffed angrily. She didn't like this person one bit, and each time she saw him, well, let's just say he didn't do his image any favors.
"Oh, the gamer gremlin is here too!" David voiced and then glanced at Nyx and Aria, "And would you look at that, the hooker gang stands united once again!"
Luna's gaze darkened as fury overtook her features. "I warned you, call me a prostitute one more time, and I will ruin you! [Storm-"

She was abruptly interrupted when Kaiden put his hand in front of her mouth. Luna angrily turned toward him to ask why he stopped her, but her question didn't leave her lips. It simply couldn't. What she saw was a sight she'd never seen before. If she was furious, then Kaiden was outright boiling with pure, unadulteratedwrath.

His entire demeanor shifted. His usual laid-back, confident posture stiffened, and a dark, threatening aura settled around him. The warmth in his gaze vanished, only to be replaced by murderous eyes that made the air around him feel insufferably heavy. Even the paparazzi's constant camera clickings ceased abruptly.
Although their eyes showed them the vision of a young man, all observers could swear that, in reality, they saw only one thing: one monster. The worst of them all.
Vespera Ashborn.
Only she had this presence to her. He looked like the male version of the Shadow Monarch when she was about to go on a rampage against those stupid enough to earn her ire.
David's eyes widened in fright, and his mockery ceased immediately. He took an instinctive step back as his bravado crumbled.
"W-w-what do you want?!" he yelled in a much higher pitch than he wanted to.

Kaiden spat his words with venom. "I warned you already. No one has the right to speak of these precious existences in such a despicable manner, not you, not my family, not the association chairman, not even the president of the United States. The two of us have our differences, but that gives you no right to involve my loved ones. Thus, you leave me no other choice."

He stepped toward the shaken David until he was right up against him, glaring deep into his eyes before declaring, "I, Kaiden Grey, challenge you, David Bennett, to an Awakened Duel. May my right as an awakened who had been wronged to his very core by another allow me to restore the honor of my women."
"Kai, it's fine!" Aria shouted with worry overwhelming her entire being.
"Yeah, this loser's words do not affect me," Nyx nodded.

Luna was about to voice her agreement when Kaiden turned toward them and looked deep into each of their eyes one by one. He said no words, but they instinctually understood one thing. Kaiden was furious beyond reason. He wanted to beat David up.
Hehadto.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Kaiden’s Challenge
paragraphs: Each of them knew that an F-tier lived in a completely different world from an A-tier. The chances of Kaiden coming out victorious were statistically below one percent, they each understood it perfectly well...

... But when they saw the fire of determination burning brightly in his eyes, any such voice of reason left their minds immediately, only to be replaced by the fervent belief they held toward the man who saved them from self-destructing due to the miserable hand life dealt them. The man who they adored more than any of them ever thought possible.

It felt as if their entire beings vehemently rejected the very idea that Kaiden could lose this battle. Whether it was their Sinsworn Valkyrie selves influencing their brains to have such a strong trust in their Paragon of Sin or if it was just their madly in love feminine brains trusting the man who swooped them off their feet, they didn't know, but neither did it matter.
They offered no further resistance, instead stepping up close behind him in a show of utmost support.
"An F-tier challenged an A-tier awakened!!!" A woman screamed excitedly once she finally managed to come out of the daze Kaiden inflicted upon them with his sheer, overwhelming menace.
"Is this a first in history?!" a man shouted and began taking dozens of pictures per second.
"Is he insane or what?" another asked.
Hearing these statements, David couldn't help but remember that he was, in fact, a supreme existence, an A-tier awakened, while Kaiden was a bottom-of-the-barrel nobody.

"I accept. You know that an Awakened Duel has to have a wager, right? It's impossible, but just to satisfy the rules, tell me what you want in case you overcome the odds and win," David said with a confident smirk.
"You to get on all fours and apologize, one by one, to each of my lovers," Kaiden replied without needing a single moment to think.
"Confidence is key, as they say... Haha. I'm amazed at your belief in yourself-"
"Cease your incessant yapping, bastard," Kaiden interrupted his monologuing.
"Hm. I see how it is. Alright, you don't have anything that I would want, so I'll settle for ten thousand dollars- no, since we're awakened now, let's make it a hundred Chronos."
"Deal," Kaiden accepted the wager instantly.
The reporters couldn't believe their ears. Did the F-tier truly accept such an unfavorable wager? An apology versus a large amount of money?

This was the juicy story each of them had been craving, so they eagerly continued their recording as they followed the pair who went into a different part of the Awakened Association to notify the organization of their request.
An Awakened Duel was an officially recognized challenge overseen by the association. It had to be conducted in a specific arena and refereed by a professional.

The administrative process was swift; the two men soon found themselves facing each other in the arena. Numerous people filled the audience seats because this was a rare occurrence. Not the part where they could see an F-tier fight against an A-tier, but the part where they could personally see the might of an A-tier combatant.

A-tiers were like demigods among men, and there was no doubt in anyone's mind either the government or a high-tier guild would quickly run at David with offers of unimaginable wealth in exchange for having him join them. Most people had only ever seen an A-classed person on their screens, never in person. It was a special privilege to see what one was capable of.
To them, Kaiden was just a target dummy to be used by the new phenom to display his might, nothing more, nothing less.
"Do you think he is a warrior-type?"
"Maybe a rogue! He kinda looks like a sleazy scumbag, that archetype might fit him better."
"Nah, he gotta be a mage! They are all spineless cowards; he fits right into the archetype. He nearly shat himself when the F-tier glared at him."
"So did you, and you not just 'nearly.'"
"... I'm not an A-tier awakened..."
Many such conversations took place in the audience.

The referee was a man in his thirties who looked very businesslike. "Allow me to relay the rules. This arena has been created with the special intention of being used by awakened to settle their differences. Your spells will not be able to leave the arena's edges, and your lives will also be safe. You can sustain injuries, but in case of a serious threat to your life, the arena itself will teleport you away to safety. The fight will last until one of you surrenders or gets teleported to safety. You didn't ask for any specific rules to be implemented, so that's it from me. Walk to the edge of the arena on your side and wait for my mark to begin."
Both men did as told.
"Kai, you can do it!" Nyx shouted from the top of her lungs. Many eyes turned toward her, but she couldn't care less.
"That's one of the women who got wronged by the A-tier..."
"I heard a rumor saying she might be a pornstar..."
"Kekeke! I wonder if they will remain loyal to him once he gets pummeled here!"
"K-K-Kai, I believe in you!" Luna yelled with some difficulty. The Storm Valkyrie was not ready to embrace the way of shamelessness like Nyx very evidently was.
"Kai!!! I love you!!!" Aria screamed with even more vocal strength than Nyx did, shocking both women and the entire audience.
"What is this cheerleading squad? Is he a pop idol or what?"
"Nah, they're all his lovers. He is fighting to restore their honor like a medieval knight."
"Oh! I didn't know what the reason behind this duel was, but now that I know, I can't help but hope the F-tier wins!" a woman announced while eyeing Kaiden with newfound respect and interest.
"Same! He is much more handsome than David, anyway. When he loses, I'll give him a hundred dollars to help with his debt," a second female announced.

"Man, that dude sure is lucky. His class might be F-tier, but his women are all S-tier..." A lot of men grumbled with a great deal of jealousy evident in their tones. Seeing these three bombshells embrace being members of a harem in broad daylight was a strange sight to observe. It was more or less unheard of in the modern Western world. A man having multiple lovers was one thing, but having them publicly announce their support and love for their man was another one entirely.
"Ready?" the referee asked. After both nodded, he continued, "On my mark. Three, two, one, begin!"

sentences.text: Each of them knew that an F-tier lived in a completely different world from an A-tier.
The chances of Kaiden coming out victorious were statistically below one percent, they each understood it perfectly well...

But when they saw the fire of determination burning brightly in his eyes, any such voice of reason left their minds immediately, only to be replaced by the fervent belief they held toward the man who saved them from self-destructing due to the miserable hand life dealt them.
The man who they adored more than any of them ever thought possible.
It felt as if their entire beings vehemently rejected the very idea that Kaiden could lose this battle.

Whether it was their Sinsworn Valkyrie selves influencing their brains to have such a strong trust in their Paragon of Sin or if it was just their madly in love feminine brains trusting the man who swooped them off their feet, they didn't know, but neither did it matter.
They offered no further resistance, instead stepping up close behind him in a show of utmost support.
"An F-tier challenged an A-tier awakened!!!" A woman screamed excitedly once she finally managed to come out of the daze Kaiden inflicted upon them with his sheer, overwhelming menace.
"Is this a first in history?!" a man shouted and began taking dozens of pictures per second.
"Is he insane or what?" another asked.
Hearing these statements, David couldn't help but remember that he was, in fact, a supreme existence, an A-tier awakened, while Kaiden was a bottom-of-the-barrel nobody.
"I accept.
You know that an Awakened Duel has to have a wager, right?
It's impossible, but just to satisfy the rules, tell me what you want in case you overcome the odds and win," David said with a confident smirk.
"You to get on all fours and apologize, one by one, to each of my lovers," Kaiden replied without needing a single moment to think.
"Confidence is key, as they say...
Haha.
I'm amazed at your belief in yourself-"
"Cease your incessant yapping, bastard," Kaiden interrupted his monologuing.
"Hm.
I see how it is.
Alright, you don't have anything that I would want, so I'll settle for ten thousand dollars- no, since we're awakened now, let's make it a hundred Chronos."
"Deal," Kaiden accepted the wager instantly.
The reporters couldn't believe their ears.
Did the F-tier truly accept such an unfavorable wager?
An apology versus a large amount of money?

This was the juicy story each of them had been craving, so they eagerly continued their recording as they followed the pair who went into a different part of the Awakened Association to notify the organization of their request.
An Awakened Duel was an officially recognized challenge overseen by the association.
It had to be conducted in a specific arena and refereed by a professional.
The administrative process was swift; the two men soon found themselves facing each other in the arena.
Numerous people filled the audience seats because this was a rare occurrence.
Not the part where they could see an F-tier fight against an A-tier, but the part where they could personally see the might of an A-tier combatant.

A-tiers were like demigods among men, and there was no doubt in anyone's mind either the government or a high-tier guild would quickly run at David with offers of unimaginable wealth in exchange for having him join them.
Most people had only ever seen an A-classed person on their screens, never in person.
It was a special privilege to see what one was capable of.
To them, Kaiden was just a target dummy to be used by the new phenom to display his might, nothing more, nothing less.
"Do you think he is a warrior-type?"
"Maybe a rogue!
He kinda looks like a sleazy scumbag, that archetype might fit him better."
"Nah, he gotta be a mage!
They are all spineless cowards; he fits right into the archetype.
He nearly shat himself when the F-tier glared at him."
"So did you, and you not just 'nearly.'"
I'm not an A-tier awakened..."
Many such conversations took place in the audience.
The referee was a man in his thirties who looked very businesslike.
"Allow me to relay the rules.
This arena has been created with the special intention of being used by awakened to settle their differences.
Your spells will not be able to leave the arena's edges, and your lives will also be safe.
You can sustain injuries, but in case of a serious threat to your life, the arena itself will teleport you away to safety.
The fight will last until one of you surrenders or gets teleported to safety.
You didn't ask for any specific rules to be implemented, so that's it from me.
Walk to the edge of the arena on your side and wait for my mark to begin."
Both men did as told.
"Kai, you can do it!" Nyx shouted from the top of her lungs.
Many eyes turned toward her, but she couldn't care less.
"That's one of the women who got wronged by the A-tier..."
"I heard a rumor saying she might be a pornstar..."
"Kekeke!
I wonder if they will remain loyal to him once he gets pummeled here!"
"K-K-Kai, I believe in you!" Luna yelled with some difficulty.
The Storm Valkyrie was not ready to embrace the way of shamelessness like Nyx very evidently was.
"Kai!!!
I love you!!!" Aria screamed with even more vocal strength than Nyx did, shocking both women and the entire audience.
"What is this cheerleading squad?
Is he a pop idol or what?"
"Nah, they're all his lovers.
He is fighting to restore their honor like a medieval knight."
"Oh!
I didn't know what the reason behind this duel was, but now that I know, I can't help but hope the F-tier wins!" a woman announced while eyeing Kaiden with newfound respect and interest.

Three, two, one, begin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 69: First Fight of the Paragon of Sin
paragraphs: "Let me show you the might of my class, Arcane Archmage!" David yelled as he aimed his right hand at him and pointed with his finger, "[Arcane Bolt]!"

Kaiden wasn't just standing around like a dumbass while his enemy got ready—he was already in a posture that made him ready to pounce, and he did just that. Even before the transparent blue projectile was shot at him, he was dodging to the side.

That being said, he didn't anticipate the extreme velocity of this spell, it was like a bullet shot from a barrel. The only reason Kaiden escaped being teleported to safety as soon as the battle started was thanks to his quick reaction, coupled with David's unfamiliarity with both combat in general and with his spells in specific. Neither of them used their classes before this moment in time.

There was still a good distance separating them, so Kaiden elected to use his gap-closing ability. He understood the strategy that had to be utilized perfectly well. Against a mage, you gotta get up close and personal so that you can beat the shit out of them with your fists.

It was time to use his class, Paragon of Sin—a class built around the seven deadly sins as stances, each granting the holder unique abilities. However, the Heavenly Demon had restricted Kaiden's access to its full might until he proved himself worthy of being the successor by ranking the Demonic Pornstar System up multiple times. For now, he could only access a single stance.
"Mode: Wrath."

The moment Kaiden uttered the words, a palpable shift swept through the arena. His eyes shifted in color, flaring a deep, blood-red. They were glowing like embers of a raging inferno. It wasn't just a color change, though. There was a feral intensity to them, a wordless promise of violence.

The air around him grew heavy, vibrating with malevolent energy, making it harder to breathe for David. Even the referee gulped. As a high-tier, high-leveled person, these rookies should have utterly no effect on him, especially not the F-tier. Yet... he did.
Everyone nearby felt it—the raw, unending craving for violence radiating off of Kaiden.
He had become the harbinger of wrath.

That did not mean that Kaiden lost control of himself; he didn't become a raging wild beast. No, he was in full control, but the violent tendencies he could normally keep under a soft blanket, like most people in society, were freed—allowed to rampage freely.

Being the Paragon of Sin was not about overcoming archaic trials where your mind was invaded by overwhelming thoughts reminiscent of each sin. It was about using those sins as stances to reign supreme both on the battlefield and in life in general.

Kaiden tried silently casting his next spell, but nothing happened. It made sense in his head since the abilities he could cast silently were gained directly from the system and were labeled as 'skills' while the abilities normal awakened had were called 'spells.' His Paragon of Sin class was given to him by the system but not governed by the system. It was a normal class like any other.

Kaiden knew time was of the essence; he couldn't dwell on this topic. He had to put the man who became too arrogant for his own good in his place. "[Warpath]!" He bellowed, charging at David with twice the speed his body was capable of normally. This ability gave Kaiden a 25% damage reduction as well as increased speed, but it had a long cooldown. He knew he had to make good use of this chance.
"[A-Arcane Bolt]!" David yelled while accidentally biting into his tongue. The sight of the tall, menacing man rushing at him like a mad bull was downright terrifying.
The same bolt shot through the air and hit Kaiden in the shoulder, where it etched itself deep into his muscles. He winced from the pain but managed to bear with it.

His charge did not slow down despite the blood trickling from the wound. Even with the damage reduction's help, it was like being shot by a 9mm pistol. Kaiden was just too angry; his veins pumped full of adrenaline to care. All he could think about was seeing David's broken form apologizing to his girls.

"S-stop! Don't come any closer! [Arcane Pulse]!" His enemy screamed and turned both of his palms toward Kaiden, then physically pushed them forward as if he wanted to shove him back physically. His spell immediately shot out from his hands and hit Kaiden squarely in the chest, sending him flying back toward the edge of the arena from where he started.
*Thud!*

His battered body hit the ground, making his three lovers gasp in fright, accompanied by some in the audience who couldn't help but cheer for the underdog. Yes, most of them were female. The men were still too jealous due to the beauty of his girlfriends.
"Haha! You gave me a scare! Are you sure this class of yours is F-tier?" David shouted as bravery returned to him once he saw his opponent's unmoving figure on the ground.

"Seeing that I'm standing without a single scrape while you're lying on the ground with multiple injuries, I suppose the association made no mistake in the end. I think this is the time when we put an end to our childish rivalry. I'll be scouted by a top guild and make mountains of money while you will go back to uni and become an economist. You know what, I'm magnanimous; I'll hire you as my financial advisor if you prove yourself worthy."

Kaiden groaned in extreme pain. His body was that of a normal human because he was still level 1. Humans were not made sturdy enough to take such damage and remain in fighting condition. Yet, the Paragon of Sin couldn't allow himself to lose. Kaiden made a sudden move by aiming his hand at David and intoning, "[Fiery Burst]!"
A torrent of flames abruptly erupted from his fingers and shot toward David, where they exploded as if he'd just thrown a grenade at him. Numerous gasps sounded from the audience.
Did the F-tier just win?

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Shock
paragraphs: As the smoke settled around the Arcane Archmage, his pristine form became visible. He was surrounded by a light blue colored transparent shield that was showing cracks due to the damage it sustained. David stroked his chin nonchalantly, observing the capabilities of his class. "[Arcane Shield], hmm... It just saved me from a great deal of embarrassment. I'm loving this class of mine more and more!"
Kaiden used the few precious seconds his sneak attack granted him to gather his bearings and stand on shaky legs.

"An ability to run fast and a fire spell, what a strange class you have, my old rival. What is the name? Red Bull? Eh, no matter... it's time I put you out of your misery. You need imminent medical attention."
Kaiden didn't reply to his constant monologuing, instead using this chance to breathe in and out slowly, regaining control over his body in full. Then, he started sprinting at his enemy.

"Hah? You can still move so well? Your perseverance is amazing; you're like a human cockroach. [Arcane Lance]." David was quickly becoming better at utilizing his class. His aim was horrible in the beginning, but in this short span of time, he got acclimated to combat rather admirably, which was best evidenced by the spear made from arcane energy impaling Kaiden right through his stomach.

"Gh!" Kaiden grunted just before spitting a mouthful of blood from his lips, yet his brightly burning eyes never dimmed. He gathered all his strength, and with the lance still being etched into his body, he jumped at David. While in mid-air, he raised his right fist and shouted, "[Doom Strike]!"
Blood spilled all over the arena from his mouth and the fatal wound in his stomach as the Paragon of Sin descended on his adversary.

His fist connected with the transparent shield and immediately shattered it apart into millions of useless little pieces. Its damage threshold had been reached and breached. Kaiden grabbed David by the throat as the two men plummeted to the ground. David lay on his back with Kaiden sitting on top of him with his knees resting on the ground on either of his sides.

Kaiden moved his head closer to David's and tried to say something, but only terrifying, guttural sounds left his throat, making him seem like a less man and more like a demon incarnate. A sickening amount of his blood flew down onto his enemy lying beneath him.
As for David, he was in the middle of pissing himself.
Literally.

The sight of Kaiden was straight-up nightmare fuel. David was just a college dork playing games late into the night, and now he was having a battle against a furious, dying opponent who simply refused to keel over. It was just too much for him.

Seeing he was incapable of speech and knowing he didn't have much longer, Kaiden moved in for the kill. He kept his left hand firmly around David's throat and raised his right hand, formed it into a fist, and brought it down on the man with all the strength he could muster.

Kaiden kept training himself religiously through the past month, and it showed. His foundations were much greater than before. "Arghh!" David screamed when the arena's ground gave him the second punch due to the force with which Kaiden's fist connected with his skull. "[Arcane Bo-]" He intoned but was silenced when the next slug landed on his jaw, breaking it with a loud crunch. Kaiden's grip around his throat tightened as well, not wishing to give his opponent any chances to fight back.
By now, the fight had completely left David. He was scared beyond reason and was fearing for his life. He wanted to surrender but wasn't allowed to—the next punch had already connected with his head.

The spell Kaiden was waiting to come off cooldown was available once again. He raised his fist high into the air for the final time. An extremely satisfied shine could be seen in his burning crimson-red eyes.

Kaiden couldn't form words properly due to all the blood oozing from his mouth, but the guttural sounds he emitted seemed to be more than enough. [Doom Strike] came down on David's defenseless head as if it were an executioner's axe and fractured his skull with a brutal, echoing sound accompanying the impact of his strike.
David was immediately teleported to safety, after which Kaiden stared at the empty spot where his opponent lay just a moment ago before slumping forward—every ounce of strength left his body.

He was succumbing to his wounds. The adrenaline and sheer willpower that kept him going all this while finally ran out of gas. He followed right after David as he was also teleported to safety, where the medical staff could immediately begin working on preserving his life. This was exactly the reason why an Awakened Duel could only take place when a high-tier healer was present.

The referee continuously stared with utter disbelief at the place where the two figures of the combatants lay a second ago, but now only a worrying amount of blood remained in their wake. "T-the winner of the duel is K-Kaiden Grey!" he shouted the words he never expected himself to utter when he received the task of overseeing this comically unfair combat.

While it was true that right after awakening was the time when the gap between high and low tiers was the smallest because it would continuously widen each time they leveled up, it was still astounding for such a wide gap to be overcome.

This F-tier awakened may've made history today, the referee thought. But then, he couldn't help but remember back to the overwhelming presence Kaiden had on the battlefield. He didn't emit the usual fragile, vulnerable aura weak-classed individuals tended to, making him question if the artifact finally made a mistake after all these years of having a pristine track record.

Immediate feminine screaming erupted as the ladies in the audience who were rooting for the underdog stood from their seats and began celebrating, while most of the men only sat frozen in their seats with disbelieving eyes adorning their features.
However, the three maidens whose honor had been wronged by the accused were nowhere to be seen, for they immediately rushed toward the healing room with eyes releasing rivers of tears.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Reaction of the Chairman
paragraphs: "The son of Vespera... There's no doubt about that," the chairman of the Awakened Association murmured after he finished watching the recording of the duel that took place between the two newly awakened youths.

"Yes. The Ashborn household was a cautious family who kept their children's names hidden until they awakened, presumably to allow them a normal upbringing in public. Kaiden Ashborn was never registered in any government database, even before the apocalypse struck. However, our team managed to uncover a few photographs of him being escorted by the family's butler to school. Our analytics department reconstructed what Kaiden would have looked like as a child, and the face they derived perfectly matched the one we see in the photos."
Grace, the chairman's secretary, informed before she continued.

"We managed to discover the most likely reasoning behind Kaiden's disowning. An adult entertainment studio had just released three videos in which he starred as the male lead, and the three women who were called compromising names by the A-tier awakened David Bennett were the female leads. Vespera likely got wind of the situation and swooped in before Kaiden could carelessly use his name as an adult actor, bringing shame to the family and the entire New Dawn guild."

"Haaah... That woman will be the end of me, I swear. Why is everything so difficult when it comes to her?" the chairman grumbled right after sighing tiredly. "Didn't the little sister assault a group of awakened just yesterday?"

"Yes, according to Alice Ashborn's recounting of the events, they were speaking in an ill-mannered way about Kaiden Grey. We are waiting for them to regain consciousness—if they do at all—to hear their part of the story."

"Haaah..." The chairman sighed once again while massaging his temples. He was a mighty existence on the level of the strongest tier of awakened, but he had the sworn duty of maintaining peace through more diplomatic methods, forcing him to have a lot of headaches while dealing with the awakened people, and none gave him stronger migraines than Vespera Ashborn.

Usually, it was because she had a body count of murdered awakened in the thousands that kept increasing nearly every day she stepped out of her home, forcing the association to sweep things under the rug instead of bringing her to court as that would be a beyond futile effort. But now it was for an even more annoying issue.

They'd been studying the mana apocalypse religiously ever since it occurred, and Kaiden and his three women were truly interesting cases. They each awakened together, all three females had Valkyrie-named classes and were even recognized to have the same potential output by the artifact as Kaiden's Paragon of Sin class, as if their strength level was connected to his.

Each awakened tier was categorized by the strength of the signal the artifact emitted upon their reading, but within the same class, disparities happened all the time. No two separate classes had the same reading. Yet, somehow, all four of them had the exact same output.

Vespera's threats forced the association to decide between losing one of their strongest awakened and having her join China, the country who were the most threatening to the continued peace of global dominance of the USA due to its large populace of awakened people and the iron grip the CCP held over them, or giving up on studying such a rare and curious phenomenon.
The chairman was undecided about which route to take until he received a call from the president himself and was ordered to stand down, no questions asked.
"Grace... Tell me more about this boy and his harem."
"Yes, sir," the secretary nodded in acknowledgment.

"According to our information, Aria Levander was a trainer in the gym Kaiden Grey began frequenting a month ago. The two of them might've met there. What we know for certain is the four of them signed with the same casting agency, and according to the casting agent who we questioned, they hit it off immediately once Kaiden earned the right to be filmed with all three women instead of only with one of them as was originally intended. Zadie is the casting agent's name, and she said that besides being incredibly promising young actors, she noticed no irregularities save for the extreme care Kaiden showered each of them with and that the women were too calm for actresses who were there for their first-ever filming, but she accredited the latter to be the result of the former."

Grace took a deep breath before continuing, "Kaiden and the three women refused to sign a contract with Zadie for a reason she didn't know, but since then, we'd discovered it was due to them wanting to be independent. They likely awakened during the filming or sometime around that time frame because they are now uploading adult content to the awakened platform. There's only one thing that's strange about their content, and it's the camera with which they record. Our guess for now is that Vespera gave Kaiden a never-before-seen artifact which allowed him to record from a first-person point of view."
"I see...thatorganization must be mad about this artifact. Weren't they developing a mana camera with the same proposed functions?"
"Yes, but unless Vespera can—and has the intention to—mass produce, it won't affect their sales."
The chairman nodded, "Alright. Let's wrap this up for now. Thanks for your hard work."
"It's my duty, sir," Grace bowed her head.
"That reminds me, please continue surveilling them. Including the content they upload."
"I'll assemble a team immediately-"
She was cut off. "I don't trust others. These four are not only a truly special case study, but we must monitor what they do to estimate Vespera's next moves. Thus, I want you to do it."

Grace couldn't help but grimace strongly upon hearing her new orders. She understood the reasoning, but she was a highly accomplished woman who was high-up in the government's pecking order even before the apocalypse hit Earth. Hence, the heavy frowning on her delicate face was more than understandable. After all, she was ordered to watch porn just now. She never expected such an order to be issued, but she was loyal and dutiful. Thus, she bowed once again and muttered, "... Yes, sir."

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Aftermath of the Duel
paragraphs: A couple hours after the duel, in the awakened hospital.

David awoke with a frightened shout as images of the profusely bleeding Kaiden sitting on top of him and beating the ever-living shit out of him entered his mind. He started trembling as a cold breeze enveloped him.
"Pathetic."

A deep, masculine voice sounded from next to his hospital bed. He snapped his head toward the origin of the voice and came face to face with a man who could best be described as a mafia boss. He was scarred all across his face with numerous cut wounds, and he even wore a black eyepatch over his left eye. He wore a dark trench coat and had a cigar in his mouth.
"W-who are you?" David yelped in fright.
"Victor Thorne, leader of the Blood Pact," he replied matter of factly.

Blood Pact was not an officially recognized guild but more so an underground organization. They were shrouded in mystery; there was almost no public information available about them. They were a very shady and secretive bunch.

"And you're David Bennett, the loser who was humiliated by an F-tier. You're the laughingstock of the awakened community—numerous videos are swirling about your haughty statements and consequent beating all across the country. The girl you broke up with received so much love and support she was even approached by an advertisement company about getting featured in an ad for a therapy session for women who deal with relationship issues or have low self-confidence. Hear this!"

Victor began snickering; he found what he was about to say to be very funny. "She was approached by a famous rockstar who found her story to be touching and said that to him, what's below the surface is so much more important than what's on top of it. There's a good chance that your ugly-as-sin ex is dating a rockstar right now! While you're recovering from getting such a beating from an F-tier that you pissed yourself, which was caught in 4k! Many 4k cameras at that! You can see it happening from a complete 360-degree angle! Hahaha!"

David was at first scared when he learned just who the man sitting in his hospital room was, but due to the man's great ridiculing and extremely mocking tone, he couldn't help but become enraged. "What do you want?! How did you come here in the first place?" There was no way the hospital staff would allow a stranger to enter an unconscious man's room.
"I snuck in, duh," Victor shrugged his shoulders as if it should've been obvious. "As for why I'm here... to give you an offer. A choice, if you will."
"You want to recruit me?"

"Oh, you're a smart one! It's good to see that the blonde bitch managed to restore your brain to a functioning state despite you becoming a certified vegetable. Blunt trauma to the head is no joke, let me tell you that much."
A vein bulged on David's forehead out of anger. He was getting very agitated. "Answer me!"

"Oh! Please do excuse me. My mother always told me I should strive to make a better first impression when meeting new people. I guess I never learn..." Before David could interject, Victor's tone turned serious as he stared at the man authoritatively. "Swear your undying loyalty to the Blood Pact, and we'll help you put this horrible humiliation of a lifetime behind you. It will be a relic of the past."
"... What do you mean?"

"Trying to delete what's already on the net is a futile endeavor, but we can overshadow the news with more shocking ones. Which do you think is more interesting? A level 1 A-tier awakened getting his ass beat by an F-tier, or..." His features contorted to a terrifying degree, so much so that he started looking like the devil, the personification of evil. "... An attempt on the life of the president of the United States by a Russian awakened terrorist?"
A day after the duel, in the awakened hospital.
"He's coming to... He will open his eyes at any second now," a woman whose voice Kaiden didn't recognize stated.
"Really?!" Aria's gorgeous voice chirped. Kaiden's eyelids were very heavy; he had to gather his strength for a bit before he could part them.
"Thank you, Lady Elysia!" Luna shouted with a coarse voice.'She was crying a lot...'Kaiden thought inwardly.
"Kaiden, can you hear us?" Nyx asked worriedly. Her voice came from very close, so much so that he felt the side of her head suddenly touching his chest.
"His heart is beating, of that I can assure you, young lady..." the same voice, which he couldn't recognize, muttered wryly.
"Ah! I wasn't doubting your expertise, Miss Elysia!"
"I know," the woman replied in a serene, patient tone. Kaiden couldn't help but picture her as an angel in human form. She sounded like a kind, compassionate soul.
He finally had enough strength to part his eyelids. An instant chorus welcomed his actions.
"Kai!!!" his three lovers shouted simultaneously while doing their best to hug him close to them.

"Ladies... Are you trying to assault my patient?" based on her tone, she was merely joking, but that was enough to make the girls recognize the errors of their ways. They reluctantly backed off to give the doctor the space she needed. The woman, evidently called Elysia, stepped up to his bed.

Kaiden glanced up at her and saw a young, gorgeous lady who had long blonde hair. The image he formed in his head based on the voice he heard while he had his eyes closed matched with her kind face perfectly.
He couldn't help but think that he had seen her somewhere before. "Nice to meet you, Kaiden. I'm Elysia, your doctor," she greeted him with a gentle smile.

"S-tier healer type awakened..." Kaiden murmured when he managed to match her face to the information he knew. She was a famous person who had saved numerous lives. Elysia was one of the most protected people on Earth. Some even joked her personal bodyguard unit rivaled the president's.

He glanced around, and indeed, a dozen men and women in professional uniforms stood around the edges of his room, blending into the background. He felt every move of his was watched and scrutinized as they looked for any potential threat to her life.
"You recognize me? I'm honored," Elysia replied while her kind smile never left her lips.
"Only hermits who'd been living under a rock for the past few years wouldn't recognize you..."

"Hehe! You cracking jokes is a good sign. May I check you for signs of trouble?" she asked while pointing at his head. Kaiden didn't understand what she meant but nodded nonetheless. She placed her soft, warm palm on his forehead and intoned, "[Body Scan]." Elysia closed her eyes and concentrated for a good few seconds before her delicate eyelids parted, and her cheery smile returned. "All good! You can leave the hospital in 24 hours if no trouble occurs during that time window."
"Thank you," Kaiden nodded, happy with the words of his doctor.
"You're welcome. Other patients are waiting for me, so I'll take my leave. See you around, Blood Knight," Elysia said her goodbyes, accompanied by a playful wink.
As Kaiden watched the blonde-haired woman leave his room accompanied by her bodyguard unit, a smile emerged on his lips. There were just so many exciting things he had to look forward to!

Their first dungeon rise was looming on the horizon, where he would finally get to begin his leveling journey. However, before visiting their first dungeon, they needed to purchase good gear using the awakened platform's marketplace, which stimulated Kaiden's mind greatly. What weapon should he choose? A sword? An Axe? A Spear? So many possibilities swirled in his head.

And although he didn't know it yet, many more surprises were waiting for Kaiden. Aria has been secretly collecting her bravery, intending to no longer be the sole Valkyrie who didn't shoot a video with Kaiden onto their Valhalla's Sinner awakened page, and the time would soon come to learn what forced Nyx to sign up for the casting where they met for the first time.

Furthermore, forces were in motion whose existence Kaiden wasn't even aware of: the mysterious Blood Pact, the Awakened Association, the Ashborn family, the R&D company intending to release the world's first-ever first-person mana camera who would not look kindly upon Kaiden's unique skill that allowed him to record pristine quality films with his eyes, and so much more.
All that is to say...
The journey of the Paragon of Sin and his Sinsworn Valkyries was only just beginning.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Hospitalized
paragraphs: "Thank you," Kaiden nodded, happy with the words of his doctor.
"You're welcome. Other patients are waiting for me, so I'll take my leave. See you around, Blood Knight." Elysia said her goodbyes, accompanied by a playful wink.

"Blood Knight?" He asked dumbfoundedly, but Elysia only smiled slyly while she and her armed entourage left his room, leaving behind three teary-eyed girls who each jumped at him with a potent mixture of joy and relief. Now that the doctor had left the room, they could embrace him to their heart's content.
"Kai!! You Dummy!" Aria cried. Based on her tone, she was grateful for him standing up to defend her honor but also strongly reprimanded him for taking such a stupid risk at the same time.
"Our handsome knight in shining armor..." Nyx decreed proudly as she lay a big, loving smooch on his forehead. "Thank you."
"There's nothing to thank me for. I just did what I felt was right."
"Hehe! Even now, he is spouting this nonsense! You gave us a real fright, you know?" Luna giggled while holding his hand tightly to her chest.
"How long was I out?"
"A day," They replied together in sync.
"... Based on your disheveled hair and dark bags under your eyes, is it fair to assume you stayed here with me all this time?"
"Of course."

Kaiden sighed at their determined replies. He could guess going home didn't even occur in their minds. To be fair, he would've done the same if their places were switched, and he would be lying if he said that this gesture of theirs didn't warm his heart.
"What about your siblings, Aria?"
"I called the babysitter, but honestly, they're big kids. I might not do it next time."
"Do they know?"

She grimaced at his question. Although they were not national celebrities or anything like that, the videos of her shouting her love for Kaiden had spread far, so surely someone would recognize her and show it to her siblings. From that point, it wouldn't take them much research to realize she was an adult actress.
"Not yet... I'll have a talk with them sometime."
"You have to do it soon. If you don't tell them, their classmates will. It's better if they receive the news from you."
"I know..." Aria shook her head, letting her trademark beautiful, cheery smile replace her grimace. "Let's drop this stressful topic; instead, tell us how you feel!"
Kaiden smiled at her adorable antics before replying, "Better by the second. Can you give me a rundown of what happened?"

"Sure! You silenced the arena with your victory; you were amazing!" Aria began the recounting but pouted with puffed-out cheeks when she was interrupted by an enthusiastic Luna who continued the tale.
"Both of you were teleported to safety due to your lives being at risk, and despite winning, you were in a more critical condition than the scumbag! I heard he'd already left the hospital."

It was Nyx's turn to take the mantle of speaking, eliciting a scoff from the purple-haired beauty. "We were lucky that Lady Elysia was the healer on sight. An awakened Duel can go ahead as long as an A-tier healer-type awakened is available. If it wasn't an S-tier in this case, you might've suffered lifelong crippling injuries."

Despite the Awakened Associations' best efforts to safeguard the awakened humans, Awakened Duels were still risky. No deaths ever occurred thus far, but some combatants were forced into early retirement as a result of sustaining injuries during such an event.

"Yeah. This might've been a bit reckless on my part..." Kaiden chuckled wryly when he saw the gaze of three women who were ready to beat him up due to his words. They each inhaled and exhaled a few times to calm themselves.

"Moving on, you're a small celebrity now! I checked not long ago, and the most viewed recording of your fight already crossed a million views!" Nyx squealed excitedly while shoving her phone into his face, where a Yout*be video and its views stared back at him.
"Becky sends her regards. She came to visit you a few hours ago, but you were out cold, so she asked me to tell you that she is so sorry for treating you as she did," Aria added cheerily.
Kaiden didn't remember David's ex-girlfriend treating him badly. Becky had nothing to apologize for, in his opinion.

"What about our awakened content?" Kaiden asked. He could check it himself, and he would do so soon enough, but he wanted to hear it from his happy, excited lovers. He significantly preferred seeing their adorable gazes and hearing their cheery voices over the systemic interface's cold information panel showing him what he'd missed.

"It's doing pretty good. Sadly, most views from the fight didn't seem to translate very well, but I think our ranking up the system is not far! Our Insta page received over twenty thousand followers while our awakened page got ten thousand."

They were complete nobodies before this, so Kaiden was amazed at this wonderful news. He couldn't even wrap his mind around such high numbers. Tens of thousands of people were now following them... The successor of the Heavenly Demon couldn't help but have his heart beat a bit faster out of excitement.

All three of them looked at him as if he were the dumbest person in the world.
"Dude..." Luna deadpanned.

I found it so romantic I still get butterflies in my stomach when I think back to what happened!"

"Let's take the picture for the fans," Nyx decreed. "Kai, are you good to sit up?"

"..." Luna did not reply until realization dawned on her a few seconds later. "... You wouldn't happen to be talking to me,right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Picture for the Fans
paragraphs: "Yeah, if you can call me pink bimbo, cow-uddered bitch, and many other colorful names, then there should be nothing wrong with this nickname. I came up with it while waiting for Kai to regain consciousness."
"So that’s why you were so focused!" Aria gasped.
"I don’t like it," Luna announced while crossing her arms in front of her delicate chest.
"I don’t like being called a pink bimbo either, but that never seemed to bother you, bestie." The voluptuous girl had a very smug ’check-mate’ expression adorning her gorgeous features.
"We’ll settle this later. I’m too happy right now to deal with your stupid bullshit." The purple-haired girl was too happy to engage in a catfight right now. "You wanted me to sit in his lap?"
"Yeah, that’s the only way we can all comfortably be in the picture. If I or Aria sat there, Kaiden’s face would be obstructed."
"Sure," Luna nodded, took her shoes off, and happily climbed onto his bed and hopped into his arms.

Nyx and Aria repeated her actions, but instead of on his lap, they settled on either of his sides as they rested their heads against his shoulders. "A big smile, please!" Nyx said before snapping multiple selfies.
She selected the one she liked the most and uploaded it with the caption:
’Our stalwart protector is finally awake! Thanks to Miss @Elysia, he suffered no lasting injuries!’
"Oh, someone already commented!" Nyx exclaimed in surprise and read it for them, "Kya! The Rosy Knight had been reunited with his princesses!"
"I bet that’s Sarah..." Luna murmured.
"Who?" Aria asked.
"The woman who moderates my chat. She is probably our biggest fan."
"Princeless Princess?" Kaiden inquired once he connected the dots.
"Yep."
"I see. It’s good to know that she’s not a sweaty, basement-dwelling dude. What’s with that name, though? Rosy Knight..."

It was Aria’s turn to grin excitedly as she began narrating, "While Blood Knight is a more widely spread title, in the last few hours, we got more comments from girls who were impressed with your standing up against a mighty threat and overcame the overwhelming odds to restore our honor call you as such. It’s very romantic, I love it. Look, one woman even sent you artwork." She said while fiddling around with her phone and then showed him a picture.
Kaiden begged to differ. Rosy Knight was way too effeminate for his liking, but if this got him fangirls, then so be it.

He knew very well that trying to give himself a nickname over what the public came up with was a futile endeavor. Chances were they would not start using his preferred title just because he asked nicely. At least the artwork was very well done.
It was a drawing of a knight clad in silver armor and a rosy-red colored cape. He was holding three distinct colored roses in his hands: purple, pink, and silver.

Be that as it may, it was time to finally check his messages. He sneaked his hands into Luna’s shirt and began playing with her womb-tattooed tummy while he turned his focus inward—ignored Luna’s words of cute protest—and checked his gains.
[Main Mission: ’Spark of Interest’ had been completed.]
[Rewards]
1. Random Skill Card
2. An Upgrade Point
He now had four Upgrade Points to his name.

Kaiden then opened the card with the same gacha-style ceremony accompanying it. Now that he knew the system was the creation of a mighty existence, the Heavenly Demon with the secondary title of Celestial Tyrant, he couldn’t help but laugh inwardly when he thought of the fact that this person spent time developing this cheap mobile game-like opening parade.
The card’s spinning came to a halt, and a warrior who twisted his body to dodge a spear from hitting him in the chest welcomed him.

’System... Is this a joke? If so, then you are not at all funny.’Kaiden couldn’t help but find the obvious similarity between his arcane lance-impaled state and this drawing to be of a mocking nature. The warrior on the card’s art dodged gracefully while he ’tanked’ David’s [Arcane Lance] and nearly lost his life in the process.

[Note: The Demonic Pornstar System is not capable of influencing the outcome of any randomized openings, but the Heavenly Demon didn’t leave it with any premade artwork, only the means to create them.]

’You fucker, you just admitted to being the one who drew this.’His accusation was met with cold, dead silence.’Wait, when I opened the Monster Girl Subjugator skill, you depicted a voluptuous demon woman. Was that your way to say I should aim for demons in particular?’Complete silence met his question once again, as always.
He shook his head amusedly and checked the new skill.
[Adaptive Reflexes] (B-tier)
[Adaptive Reflexes: The longer time the Successor spends locked in combat, the better his reaction times become.]

"Finally!" Kaiden exclaimed triumphantly while he grabbed onto Luna’s belly with more strength than intended. "H-hey!" she yelped with surprise due to his sudden, unexpected actions. The Storm Valkyrie had spent the past 24 hours watching her man lying on his back motionlessly, so his being this active was something her brain would need some time to get used to.
"What is it, Kai?" Aria asked while glancing up into his gaze with her beautiful crystal blue eyes.
"Let’s go to the toilet."
"Does the baby need to poopy?" Nyx asked in a playful tone, but when she realized he was serious, she decided to go along with his wishes, accompanied by the other two girls.
Kaiden easily stood from the bed. His body was as fresh as ever. Once inside the generously spacious bathroom, he spoke up with a hushed voice, "Check for bugs. Can’t have them overhear us."
They did just that and, after a few minutes, were happy with the results of their search.

"I got my first combat skill. All the previous ones were about sex in one way or another. I’m so glad to know the system can give me skills that are useful in combat!" Kaiden explained in a low whisper, after which he summoned the system’s information panel for them to read over.
"Pretty good," Nyx stated with satisfaction.
"It should be useful against mighty foes." Aria nodded in agreement.

"That reminds me, you showed us your skills back at the sushi restaurant, but I was too shocked to care, but don’t you have some ability that lets you dick down some female monsters? Do you want to talk us through what you plan to do with that, exactly?" Luna asked with a tone that was half on the brink of bursting out with overwhelming laughter due to the comical nature of the skill, but the other half was that of a jealous girlfriend who heavily questioned her boyfriend’s continued loyalty to her.

Both Aria and Nyx gasped with shock. Back at that time, they didn’t have the mental faculties to read over the entire stat page, and even if they did, their brains were too fried to remember such a skill.
Three pairs of expectant eyes stared deeply into Kaiden’s soul, forcing him to chuckle nervously before answering.
