chapters.title: Chapter 75: Jealous Girlfriends
paragraphs: Kaiden dismissively shrugged his shoulders, "I’ll breed them monster girls until they submissively kneel in front of me with trembling legs and a twitching coochie, what do you want me to say? That I won’t be using my S-tier super OP skill?"
"What would you do if I had that skill?" Luna asked with a strong edge to her tone.
His response was instantaneous. "Naturally, I would forbid you from using it."
"And you don’t find this mindset of yours to be hypocritical?"
"Not in the slightest," Kaiden nodded affirmatively.

"Hehehe..." Nyx giggled cutely. "Kai, you can be very funny at times." The Space Valkyrie had already accepted she would be sharing her man with others and found no issues with his statement because she also knew him to be a possessive lover.
"Don’t give him an easy pass! Blood Knight my ass! More like Sexist Knight of Double Standards! Hmph!" Luna protested.

"Hey, I’m no sexist. You could even call me a feminist, for I’m an advocate of true gender equality. You’ll see just how much when I indiscriminately beat the hell out of a female opponent without giving her a pussy pass."
"..." The girls stared at him for a few seconds before Aria started laughing, saying, "You failed to address the double standards part of the accusation, though?"
"I want my lawyer."

"Hehehe!" Aria giggled once again, but this time around, Kaiden couldn’t help but grimace strongly. The aura his beautiful Moon Valkyrie was giving off was sharp like a bayonet’s edge. Aria was indeed a very accommodating girlfriend in general, but unlike Nyx, she wasn’t keen on sharing her man with even more women than she already was.

And as such, the silver-haired girl equipped an ominous grin as she voiced her thoughts. "I’ve just realized your skills have some great synergy to them. [Immune Cock] and [Monster Girl Subjugator] should work well together. A pet monster like a poisonous leviathan would come in handy."
"..." Kaiden stared at the sly beauty with a wry expression. "I was thinking more along the lines of catgirls, vampire beauties, and succubi..."
"I saw a video of Scarlet slaying a monster that was called ’Thousand Poison Serpent.’ I think that would be more useful," Luna replied.
The girls understood the game Aria was playing.

"Instead of a catgirl, what about a giant hairy toad? She should be a lot stronger, she could act as our tank." Nyx joined in on the fun. Although she wouldn’t personally care if Kaiden bedded some hot monster girls, poking fun at her man was great fun she didn’t wish to miss out on.

Luna "Nah, rotting corpse golem is where it’s at when you want durability. It’s basically a superior vampire girl. Won’t annoy you with blood-feeding requests either." Luna threw oil into the fire. A cruel glint could be seen in her eyes as she was meaningfully staring into Kaiden’s own eyes.
"I heard good things about the three-headed demonic elephant. Might not be as sexy as a succubus, but its lady curves are definitely bigger," Aria added while tightening her hug around his waist.
"I got your point," Kaiden grunted painedly. "I’ll ask for all of your permission before breeding any monster girls."
"Why do you say it like we’re horribly unreasonable girlfriends?" Luna asked with an accusatory tone.
"I’m not."
"Let’s move on, shall we?"

After not receiving any refusals—the girls already had their fun at this expense—Kaiden went to check the statistics. His rank up requirements no longer showed ’???’ In place of the missions tab, letting him know he only needed to get the required statistics of views, fangirls, and income. Once he did so, another sin stance would open up to him, and once he got to level 25, the first bottleneck and met the requirements to pass to level 26, his stance abilities would become stronger.

This was where they assumed themselves to separate from normal awakened who would not gain stronger abilities but newer ones. If we take David as an example, the only way he could make his [Arcane Bolt] spell stronger was to increase his Magic stat, which would bolster his spells. But in Kaiden’s case, his [Doom Strike] and other spells would be upgraded to something else entirely once he passed the bottleneck, or so they assumed based on the system’s words.
This was how his pornstar statistics looked the last time he checked:
[Views: 15]
[Fangirls: 1]
[Income: 9]
He didn’t check how Nyx’s video was doing before the fiasco with David happened, the views only came from Luna’s shower blowjob video, and only its first hour at that.
He first checked his Views statistics.
"What?! I checked it like 27 hours ago..." He exclaimed shockedly and summoned the panel for the girls to see.
This statistic only counted the views of his adult videos. The numbers he gained with his fight on Yout*be weren’t counted, nor did Luna’s gaming stream where he was featured.

"Did Zadie upload?" He asked, and without waiting for a reply, he checked the website on his phone. The three videos combined for a meager ~20,000 views. This was a website that paywalled its content, so it made sense to have such a relatively small number. He then went to Pornh*b and saw the short demo videos combining for over 500,000 views. Knowing Zadie and her team uploaded to numerous such websites as a free advertisement, he could surmise only full-length videos were counted, or the views gained from these demos were significantly reduced. Otherwise, he would be way above 671,398.
"Kai..." Luna murmured bashfully, but she couldn’t continue due to embarrassment.

"Check your media platform." Nyx finished for her. She looked a lot more composed, or as she put it back in the Awakened Association, ’I’ve found my peace with my place in the world; I couldn’t care less what randoms think of me!’
Kaiden did as told and was faced with two videos sitting on a staggering amount of views.

Luna’s shower play was at 300,000 while Nyx’s submissive roleplay was over 350,000. The continuation of Nyx’s video was set to be a separate one and a premium one at that, but even that had 40 views. Which meant... just that alone earned them 40 Chronos, the equivalent of 4,000 dollars. A truly staggering amount. He would have to work for over 100 hours doing his night shift job at Bruno’s bar to take home the same amount he did by having steamy hot sex with his lover.
He looked up at the two girls with pure disbelief. "This is... amazing!"
"Yeah. I’m so happy! This is insane. We just started, and we’re already this successful!" Nyx nodded along cheerily.
"I don’t know about that one..." Luna murmured.

Kaiden shook his head while putting a warm expression on his face. Then, he hugged the delicate girl while murmuring, "There’s nothing to be ashamed of, my beloved Storm Valkyrie. We not only get to make tremendous amounts of money but also become mightier existences through this method, thanks to the system, and all we have to do is have fun and ignore the haters. What other people think of us matters not, especially not if it leads to us enjoying luxurious lifestyles and becoming one of the strongest beings in the world."
"Yeah, and as you said before, so long as we have each other, it doesn’t matter if everyone else hates us!" Aria chirped while putting a hand on Luna’s shoulder.

"It’s easy for you to say! There are no videos of you on the platform... I know the names of like a hundred people I’ve met in real life yet over three thousand times as many people saw me shaking my butt only for Kaiden to slap it!"

"I would like to announce that such a state of affairs will be changing within an hour or so," Aria decreed confidently, forcing Kaiden to snap his head in her direction, but she only gave him a mysterious smile in response.

paragraphs: "Are you throwing a hissy fit while hiding in our boyfriend’s warm embrace because my videos did much better?" Nyx asked in a coy tone. She glanced at Kaiden and gave him a playful wink as if to say ’Watch this!’
The reaction was instantaneous. "Haaah?!" Luna roared furiously as she let go of Kaiden’s waist and turned toward the pink-haired woman.
"What is it, Miss Chaos Gremlin? Did I say something wrong?" she asked in an innocent tone and acted as if she truly didn’t grasp the reason behind the gamer girl’s strong reaction.

"Yes, in fact, you did! The reason your video has more views is that Kaiden put your giant milkers on the thumbnail, and the incessantly drooling simps instinctively clicked on it, hopelessly getting drawn to it like moths to light!"
"I don’t see your point. Are you saying that I’m a more attractive woman? If you want, we can use my picture for the thumbnails of your videos in the future."

"???!!!" Luna’s reaction was nearly on the level Kaiden had when David called his lover hookers yesterday. That is to say, she was boiling with rage. Her features darkened, and she stomped on the ground with fury. "You’ll see, you cowkin bitch! My next video will triple the views yours get!"
"I accept the challenge, bestie." Nyx nodded with an arrogant smile.

Kaiden sent an appreciative glance at his Space Valkyrie. She was a truly great actor and a social butterfly who understood human emotions very well. He considered himself lucky to have such an amazing manipulator on his side and not against him, for he couldn’t punch ’emotional manipulation’ in the face with a [Doom Strike] like he could rude ’tards like David.

Kaiden then refocused his gaze on the statistics he gained. He wanted to leave fangirls for last, so he checked the income stat first. No matter how many people watched the videos Zadie uploaded, his income would remain at 9 because he was paid a fixed amount of $900 once the filming was concluded. Any further profit would solely go toward the company’s and its shareholders’ bank accounts.

He knew Nyx’s premium video already earned 40 Chronos, so that was 40 income. The other two videos he uploaded were free to view, but awakened content creators who uploaded to the platform still received money based on the views.

The payout was as such: for every 10,000 hours spent watching a video, the uploader would receive one Chronos. It was not 10,000 views but hours watched. Streaming had half the rate, so 20,000 hours spent watching earned the content creator a Chronos.

While it might seem an unfairly low rate at first, one must consider that, first, this money materialized from thin air, as the awakened platform generated it. Second, the awakened media platform had real-time automatic language translation, making the content uploaded to it watchable all over the world. Lastly and most importantly, everyone had access to it. You didn’t need an internet connection, electricity, signal reception, or an expensive gadget like a phone to watch.

The entire human populace of Earth was potential viewers. Ranging from wealthy businessmen in highrise buildings to redneck junkies in trailer parks, from Eskimos on the icy poles to illiterate African tribesmen running from lions in nothing but their loincloths. All had perfect access to Valhalla’s Sinners.
With his musings done, Kaiden finally checked his income.
[Income: 9 → 59.8]
’Hmm... Only 10.8 from the two videos combined.’Kaiden was a bit disappointed, but only because of how much Nyx’s premium video earned them, which distorted his expectations.
Both Luna’s and Nyx’s foreplay videos were only about ten minutes long, so six people needed to watch in full for one hour of watch time to be reached.
Furthermore, considering these videos were only slightly older than 24 hours and would continue to generate passive income until the end of time, the results were incredibly good.

To begin with, Kaiden only intended these videos to test the waters, he wasn’t disappointed when Luna’s shower play only had 15 views after an hour, yet now here he was a day later, disappointed with nearly 700k views. He felt like punching himself for being so ungrateful for their great fortune. They just earned $5k for a few minutes of ’work,’ which would likely end up being at least $7k in a month’s time without needing further input on their end.

While the non-porn-related content Kaiden uploads won’t add to the three statistics of the system, they will still earn at the same rates, and more importantly, help Valhalla’s Sinners diversify their content as he planned, so he decided to share his [First-Person Camera] recorded fight with David on the media platform. They needed money greatly to get a new home, good gear for dungeon diving, and to settle the girls’ financial troubles, so he wasn’t going to hold back. It was amazing footage, anyhow.
Kaiden found himself facing a very important crossroads when deciding on a title for it. It was time to settle on a brand for his personality.
If he gave it a title like ’Beating the shit out of an annoying pest’ he would adhere to a specific audience, likely a male-dominated violent crowd would be his most prominent viewer demographic.
If he did something boring like ’Awakened Duel against an A-tier Archmage, ’ it would be too generic and potentially brand himself as a bland person.
’My epic showdown against an A-tier Archmage’ would be fitting to draw in the edgy teenagers.

No, that title wasn’t it either. Kaiden wanted one that would adhere to adults, and both genders at that. He was especially careful to brand himself as an ideal man for the female viewerbase because of the fangirl statistic.
’Bleeding To Protect My Women: Overcoming All Odds!’
Kaiden decided to make it romantic and badass at the same time.

He included the prelude that led to the fight, namely the talk he had with David. Then he skipped the parts until he got to the arena where the fight ensued. Kaiden finished the video with him waking up in the hospital and getting embraced by the three teary-eyed lovers of his.

It was a perfect little movie that lasted about 20 minutes. He could stretch it longer but wanted it to be quality over quantity. They were in the fanbase-gathering process for now, not the fanbase-milking one.

For the thumbnail, Kaiden decided to make a little edit where he cut the frame in half. In one half, he put in a picture his mind had of his three cheery girlfriends looking like beautiful angels while glancing at him lovingly, and the other half was David’s broken skull with Kaiden’s blood smearing his face crimson red.
He couldn’t help but feel greatly excited to know how this upload will perform and to read the comments of the viewers.

With that out of the way, it was time to check the fangirl statistic. It was the bane of his existence, for he had no clue how it worked. It went beyond porn—unlike views and income—because he already had a fangirl even before starring in the Zadie-directed films.

paragraphs: With that out of the way, it was time to check the fangirl statistic. It was the bane of his existence, for he had no clue how it worked. It went beyond porn—unlike views and income—because he already had a fangirl even before starring in the Zadie-directed films.
[Fangirls: 1]
"Fucking hell!" Kaiden shouted angrily.
"What?!" Luna shouted back. She was still mad due to Nyx’s words and had been busy glaring icy daggers at her ever since the verbal clash happened between the two, so Kaiden’s shout startled her.
"I’m not getting any fucking fangirls!"
"Kai, that sounds very weird without knowing the context..." Aria giggled merrily.

"What more does the system want?! One of them even drew an artwork of me in shining silver armor!" Kaiden grumbled. "Please send her my regards, by the way," Kaiden added once he managed to calm himself.
"Already did!" Aria cheered, not at all bothered by his outburst. She gently grabbed his right hand and started massaging it before continuing, "Let’s think this through calmly, okay?"

Kaiden felt bad about shouting once he saw her warm reaction. He couldn’t help but exclaim inwardly that this girl was a true angel. "You’re right... Sorry. The only thing I can think of is either I just don’t have enough of ’me’ out there for them to get immersed in and thus become fans, or I need more variety. So far, they only know me for a single fight and two porn videos. Well, there was my appearance on Luna’s stream as well, but only a dozen people were present. I’m disappointed and, frankly, quite scared at the fact that not even the seemingly fanatic Princeless Princess woman became a fangirl."
"She is, trust me." Luna decreed once she calmed down alongside Kaiden.

"I guess then the only explanation is that the system needs more from them to be considered my fangirls. I’ve been thinking that our current recording setup is not satisfactory. Right now, only my cock is visible, which is probably not enough to fully draw in the female audience. They likely leave once their kitten gets rid of their urges."
"Oh, that’s right! We can invest in a mana camera now that we have the funds. Doing so will give us a third-person angle to work with," Nyx offered.

Kaiden shook his head. "No, we could barely afford the cheapest one, and it would result in horrible tape compared to my skill’s pristine, clear footage. I want to use this money to invest in dungeon gear; it’s high time we start leveling up."
"Then...?" Aria asked with a confused face.
"I’ll use an upgrade point," Kaiden announced with an excited grin.

Kaiden could only use upgrade points for the system’s skills and not his class’s spells, so he couldn’t upgrade the Wrath stance and its spells using Upgrade Points even if he wanted to. But with the upgrade of his classes from Pornstar to Paragon of Sin, its spell, the [First-Person Camera] became an F-tier skill instead.
All three girls had a similar reaction to his. They knew Kaiden was stockpiling Upgrade Points until the perfect opportunity arose, and it seemed he finally decided it was time.

However, Kaiden was a bit worried. If it upgraded to something like a virtual reality experience where he could record not only what he sees but also how he feels, that would be too much. He was way too possessive to share how it felt to be inside his girls. In his mind, letting the public watch them have fun was harmless; after all, his lovers would only ever do the deed with him. No one had the right to even touch their hair but him.

Therefore, if Kaiden gained such a nasty upgrade, he would become crippled as a content creator because he would refuse to use it.’You only live once...’The successor of the Heavenly Demon thought nervously while desperately begging all that was holy not to ruin his otherwise awesome day.
An Upgrade Point was RNG in the aspect that it could upgrade only one tier (possibly none at all?) or more, and it all depended on luck.

Kaiden mentally invested the point and awaited the result. A similar gacha animation played in his mind, but now it was not an opening ceremony but a giant golden hammer hitting the skill card as it was laid down on the ground. After the fifth hit, it shattered into little pieces, at which point tense music started playing.

The shattered pieces started to reassemble to create a new card. Once the final piece was added together, the tense music ceased, replaced by loud trumpets. On the surface of the card, Kaiden could see a man who heavily resembled him sitting on a throne with his cock freely dangling out in the open, but the drawing was from a strange angle as if it was drawn from the PoV of someone kneeling in front of him.
[First-Person Camera] (F-tier) → [Harem Vision] (D-tier)
[Harem Vision: The Successor may share his [First-Person Camera] with his Sinsworn Valkyries.]
"Yes!" Kaiden pumped both fists into the air victoriously.

Once he shared his upgraded skill, the girls also rejoiced, but more so because of his adorable antics. They couldn’t help but have their hearts beat a bit faster than normal when they watched Kaiden. Normally, he was so composed and confident, but the fangirl thing had been very clearly annoying him for a while, so now that he found a potential solution, his worries visibly started leaving his body in an adorably boyish manner.
’He’s so cute.’Each Valkyrie thought inwardly while having an overjoyed smile plastered on their beautiful faces.
"The news is about to start. Let’s watch it. Maybe Kai will be featured!" Aria shouted excitedly once she felt their bathroom-shushed talking had come to a satisfactory end.
"Sure."

His room was well equipped. It was the awakened hospital, after all. Only the most luxurious private hospitals could compare to the treatment the government afforded its awakened people. Therefore, a big TV hung on the wall facing his bed, but there was a second one in front of the lush sofa as well. They quickly got seated and turned it on.

The first was about a new S-tier awakened being born in China. Due to their large populace, they got the most out of the indiscriminate way the mana apocalypse functioned, namely the ~15% chance each human had to awaken.

"For the second story of the day, the United States welcomes its third A-tier awakened of the year, but there was a truly fascinating story that went with it. An F-tier-"Just as the news reporter was about to say it, the screen flashed, and a new reporter’s recording was shown.
"What the fuck?!" Luna cursed.

I was so depressed back then that I didn’t even fight back; I just wanted to be left alone.
As such, I was indebted for millions of dollars.
What’s worse is that Maximilian had been eyeing me for a long time as a woman by that point, and immediately rushed to my rescue like a dashing prince I’m sure he imagined himself to be.
He promised to pay off my debts from his own pocket if I became his.
That was all my brain needed to restart itself and immediately come out of my depression.
I told him to screw off and started doing my best to at first legally fight the contract’s validity, and when that ultimately failed, I refused to admit defeat and tried earning money.
I worked numerous jobs, but all of them failed to meet my monthly payment quotas.
At one point, I was called into his office, where I found my best friend, Alexandra, who was in the exact same situation as me.
Maximilian told us we either get on our knees and start servicing him, or he would take legal action.
I immediately turned around and began walking away, but before I left the room, to my great horror and utter disappointment, I heard a soft thud, signaling that Alexandra had admitted defeat.
Without any other choice, I signed up at the adult filming studio where we met to earn enough money to satisfy my monthly repayment quota.
You know the rest...
It seems the bastard saw our videos and got jealous, thus, he announced that ChronosX, his R&D company, was ready to hit the markets with their mana cameras made for the awakened adult industry.
Based on this ad, they have high clarity cameras of both third-person and..."

paragraphs: Kaiden knew Nyx’s story would also be harsh like his two other girls’, but her tale was especially bad.
He tightened his hands around the sobbing Nyx as he hugged her close.
Kaiden’s features darkened as he thought about Luna’s situation. "A brother who wants to sell his little sister’s innocence to his bosses..."

Then his features contorted as he recalled Aria’s circumstances. "A father who abandons all parental duties and a mother who leaves her three children alone so that she can live with her pimp of a boyfriend to get her fix."

Lastly, Kaiden’s eyes changed in color to a deep crimson as he instinctively entered Wrath mode. "Parents who blame their young daughter for their own idiocy, refusing to accept responsibility... A wealthy man doing anything that lets him further his agenda and fill his overflowing coffers..."

The Paragon of Sin spat the next words in a supernatural tone dripping with pure, unadulterated malice. It didn’t resemble a human’s voice but a terrifying demon incarnate’s."Some people just don’t deserve the privilege called breathing."

"Kai!" Aria cried out with alarm as she jumped at Kaiden to embrace him in her arms. Luna moved to grab his head and lifted it to her chest, where she stroked his hair in a calming gesture. Nyx was brought out of her wailing when she felt the atmosphere change around them. Since she was still hugged by Kaiden, all she could do was lovingly kiss his neck.

They stayed as such for a few seconds before Kaiden’s voice sounded again. "Absolve." As soon as the command left his lips, his menacing air disappeared. This was the command that let him exit his sin stances. Kaiden had no clue how he managed to enter Wrath stance without stating the words required to do so, but it was not the time to dwell on the topic.

"Thank you..." he whispered in a low, sincere tone. Kaiden didn’t know what happened exactly, but it felt as if his emotions were amplified, making him think his class tried to help him fulfill his deeply rooted desire to mete out vengeance by shedding blood. Thankfully, his girls acted in time, managing to calm him down. It wasn’t time for revenge yet—revenge was a luxury Kaiden couldn’t afford. Gaining strength had to come first.
"We’re here for you, Kai," Luna stated while massaging his scalp.
"That’s right! Thanks for caring this much, but it’s all good. Don’t worry about my issues. I’ll deal with them myself," Nyx added.
"Are you ok, Kai?" Aria asked in a worried tone.

"Yes. Nyx, I’ll have to refuse your offer. We’ll deal with these issues together, as a family should. I don’t know much about ChronosX’s plan to run us out of business, but it doesn’t matter, for we’ll crush them at their own game while growing strong enough to take them down in a direct fight. This Maximilian scum’s days are numbered—his allotted time in this plane of existence is ticking away much faster than he realizes."
"Are you saying that you will kill him?" Luna asked. Her characteristic cheeky playfulness was nowhere to be seen; the Storm Valkyrie was deadly serious.

Kaiden looked deep into her eyes before nodding. "Yes, I will. I’m not going to entrust this issue to the government. He clearly enjoys a great amount of legal immunity, I’m also not interested in court battles that will take decades. The only way to absolve Nyx from her debts is to repay them or erase the receiving party. Even if I had a trillion dollars to my name, I would still not go with the former option, so that leaves me with no other choice."

"Let’s check out the competition then." Once Luna felt how determined Kaiden was, she decided to help him. It wasn’t like she was keen on forking up the millions Nyx owed to this disgusting filth. Although killing humans was a scary concept, Luna knew each of them needed to accept that sooner or later, it would happen due to the way of life they chose for themselves. Others won’t stand by on the sidelines and let them become the strongest, richest, and most famous existences without putting up a fight.

"High-quality cameras, never before seen resolution, otherworldly fidelity and clarity..." Aria read the post on the company’s awakened platform profile. That was the battlefield where Valhalla’s Sinners had the best chance of taking on a multi-billionaire organization. That being said, while it was true that one couldn’t bribe the awakened platform to promote them in any shape or form, spending a great deal on ad campaigns in the real world translated to gaining followers on the awakened platform, so even there, they would be the underdogs—quite significantly at that.
"Damn, the follower count is racing up like crazy! It went up by like 500 in mere seconds!" Luna cursed.
"That creep ran a worldwide ad campaign using numerous media platforms, social media, cable news, and more..." Nyx voiced her findings while fiddling with her phone.
"I’m watching their uploaded content and they are not just selling, they’re uploading porn too," Kaiden added.
"Yeah, their slogan is ’Feel the Rush: Limitless Awakened Pleasure. Enjoy endless adult content from anywhere, at any time, for free of charge at ChronosX.’" Aria read.

"If they keep bombarding the populace with ads, we can expect them to get tens if not hundreds of millions of followers, after which the awakened platform’s algorithm will do the rest for them. They will become unstoppable giants single-handedly monopolizing the awakened porn industry..." Nyx said with a grim expression.
"Bruh." Kaiden couldn’t help but begin snickering. The girls eyed him funnily, not understanding what he could possibly find humorous considering the severity of their situation.
"Did you go mad from the sudden pressure of a giant conglomerate becoming our competition?" Luna asked, amused.

"Competition? Hah! I have to squint my eyes to see this woman’s neatly trimmed pubes. Yes, their third-person camera footage is a giant improvement over the mana cameras that were available on the market up until now. It’s crystal clear, like my skill’s recording, but it’s obvious they rushed the first-person camera out just to mess with us. I would be surprised if this is even Full HD quality. They felt threatened, fearing we would usurp the market and thus were forced to preemptively launch the product."

Hearing his analysis, the ladies couldn’t help but exhale, their pent-up stress lessened significantly. Finally, there was some good news. They navigated to the same page using their awakened media platforms and burst into jovial laughter in sync when they heard Kaiden tell them they were forbidden from looking at another man’s cock. The girls quickly found themselves breathing a sigh of relief after ascertaining the validity of his claims.
This meant they had a proper fighting chance.
Though...

The next day, Aria quickly sent her siblings to school and rushed back to the hospital. She was expected to work in the gym today, but after seeing their success, the girl knew she would likely be quitting so that she could fully dedicate herself to their business venture as well as leveling up in the dungeons.

Aria hoped he only needed some time to digest the news.
Once the Moon Valkyrie was back, she gave Kaiden a big hug, and the four sat down on the sofa. They promised Aria not to look at his system’s statistics until she came back.

The assassination attempt on the president’s life and the launch of ChronosX stifled the interest Kaiden’s victory rightfully should’ve brought in, but things were still looking up, incredibly so at that. They went from being no-name nobodies to having a small online presence.
His video of pummeling the shit out of David had the biggest jump, reaching 250,000 views overnight.

Nyx’s views increased by another 50,000, reaching a total of 400,000 views, and her premium video gained another 10 unlocks. Much to the pink-haired voluptuous beauty’s annoyance, Luna’s video was gaining momentum and had nearly closed in on hers at 390,000 views.
Aria’s nurse play technically resulted in 4 videos, 2 free and 2 premium.
The one Kaiden recorded had 110k views, and 15 people unlocked his premium PoV.
Aria’s PoV had only 60k views but... "What the fuck!" Luna shouted in shock.
"Damn, that’s crazy," Nyx whistled with a fulfilled grin.
"I never expected girls to be this desperate...!!" Aria muttered bashfully, with pink cheeks adorning her delicate features.
"Did they truly enjoy seeing my face this much?" Kaiden asked with disbelief.
The conversion rate of people who were willing to pay for the premium content on his videos was very low, about one in 10,000 people.
Aria’s female-oriented video had...
One in a thousand. 60 people unlocked the premium video where they could enjoy a high-quality fantasy ride on Kaiden’s shaft.
"I told you, porn is boring as hell. I didn’t watch such content for a reason. This is revolutionary for the female viewerbase," Nyx said.

Seeing Kaiden was still confused, Luna elected to elaborate. "I agree with the pink bimbo. Adult content is made to be consumed by a grand majority of male viewers, which shows in the camerawork. We straight women aren’t interested in watching how the actress looks, yet the camera keeps focusing on her alone."
"So you’re saying this video is a rare gem for women." Kaiden surmised once he got the gist of it.

"Yes," Luna nodded before explaining even further. "In general, fewer women are interested in porn but those that are, are kinda down bad. Most men just do the deed and exit the video while women tend to gain more emotional fulfillment from it. They likely loved watching how you reacted to the different ways Aria pleasured you. Furthermore, knowing the video featured the guy who heroically overcame all odds to protect his lovers’ image made the viewers deeply invested. To them, it was more than porn. It was a wonderful emotional rollercoaster that made their hearts melt from joy."

"... That’s amazing. In the end, it seems my approach to adult content was the right one. Rushing out content isn’t the correct way for long-term benefits," Kaiden concluded with a happy smile and went to check his statistics.

Views went from 671,398 to 965,000, meaning he had almost already met the requirement to rank his system up as far as the views statistic went, while he already shot past the goal for income as it went from 59.8 to 163. His fight with David had already earned them a good 8 Chronos as well, but those numbers were not counted toward the statistics of the system.

"We made more than 15,000 dollars..." Nyx whispered with disbelief. Her heart was beating faster than a racehorse’s. She was so damn excited! "Some people don’t make that much after working hard for months, yet we did it in a few hours!"
"This calls for a celebration!" Luna shouted with similar levels of excitement.

"What about the fangirls?!" Aria asked with a great deal of hope, which was evident in her big, beautiful eyes. She did the nurse roleplay to please her man first of all, of course, but also in hopes it would be the tipping point that broke the dam.
[Fangirls 1 → 12]

"It went up by eleven!" Kaiden announced with pure joy—he was finally released from the stress that was caused by the ambiguous requirements of the statistic. Well, he still didn’t get how it worked, but things were finally starting to change.

Kaiden was so happy that he grabbed Aria and planted her in his lap, after which he immediately started slobbering her in kisses. He did not doubt in his head that this big improvement came from the effort this wonderful existence put in for him.
"Leave some of her for tomorrow..." Luna grumbled as she eyed the silver-haired supermodel with jealous eyes.
She wanted to be the one who helped Kaiden get over this annoying hump!
Once he finally let go of his awesome lover, Nyx spoke up with an amused tone. "So what about the celebration?"

"We shall celebrate by entering our first-ever dungeon." Kaiden stated before continuing, "$15k is a truly insane amount, but we can’t earn this much every day. As I explained before, this business model I’ve crafted only works if the adult content we release remains a novelty, not an everyday occurrence. People were willing to shell out so much money to unlock our premium content not only because of the quality of our films but also because they found us interesting as people due to what happened with David. They were attached to our stories, our personalities. We will have to keep the momentum going by doing things that make people interested, and what better way to do that than a successful dungeon stream?"
"I’m so down!" Nyx shouted as her excitement turned into overdrive.

Kaiden would be lying if he said he wasn’t excited. To that end, he clapped his hands together, drawing everyone’s attention to him. Then, with a big grin, he declared, "Ladies, it’s time for Valhalla’s Sinners to gear up."

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Gearing Up
paragraphs: The awakened platform had a specific marketplace where people could spend Chronos to buy and sell anything supernatural. The mana apocalypse connected the world in never-before-seen ways, such as how the buying and selling procedure functioned.

Once you decide to sell something, it will magically disappear from your hands, and when someone buys it, it will materialize in front of them. For safety reasons, big items could only be purchased when you had enough space in front of you, furthermore, you couldn’t buy or sell anything inside the dungeons.
"I’m sending each of you 40 Chronos. Let’s shop, my beautiful Valkyries."

As Kaiden browsed the marketplace, it quickly became evident that the awakened lived in a completely different world from commoners. The only people who remained grounded in reality were the weakest of them, like the gardener girl with the bubbly butt who he once used as fap material.
Item rarity played a big role in determining their effectiveness. Right now, they could only afford the two lowest tiers: junk and common.

Junk-rarity gear was slightly worse than what humanity could craft before the apocalypse, but common-rarity had already surpassed that level. Anything above common-rarity had such astounding capabilities that comparing them to pre-apocalypse technology would make humanity’s millions of years of evolution look like a bad joke.

Their current amount of funds was considered to be nearly broke for an awakened who wanted to shop, so they had to be sparing. There were two sorts of armor. Individual ones and gearsets. Gearsets were cheaper because you paid for a bundle package with a discount on it, but its effects were worse. If you could assemble a set from individual items, for example, the fabled ’Blood Monarch’ set, its effects would easily triumph over a gearset of the same rarity.
Pre-assembled gearsets were termed ’bundle gear’ while sets assembled from individual pieces were called ’legacy sets.’

Kaiden and his Valkyries could only go for bundle gears for now. Heavy armor was not only too cumbersome but more expensive, so Kaiden chose a medium armor. Based on the spells of his lovers, he would be the one on the front, so he had to be able to take some hits without keeling over.

’Metal Nomad’ was the one he was looking for. It protected his most vulnerable parts with metal while giving his joints the desired freedom by only using sturdy but flexible leather in some places. Sadly, it gave no supernatural bonuses, such as imbued spells or magical resistances.

Kaiden always thought axes were ultra-badass, so he bought a common-rarity two-hander—the ’War Axe.’ Its shaft had a pointed end, allowing it to double as a spear. Furthermore, it was double-edged, with one side featuring a mean axe blade ready to inflict grievous flesh wounds, while the other had a pick-edge, perfect for piercing armor or harvesting rare metals.

The War Axe’s multi-functional nature was what attracted Kaiden. Swords and other single-bladed weapons could be enhanced to tear through armor while still being effective against unarmored enemies, but those were far beyond his budget.

And as a complete rookie, choosing a sword—or any weapon that required high mastery to wield effectively—would be a stupid mistake in his eyes. An axe fit his natural instincts: it didn’t require delicate technique to be deadly. It thrived on aggression. In Wrath stance, he could swing with raw power and still be effective.
While mastering axe combat would push his skills to another level, even from the start, it was a weapon that let him tear through enemies with sheer ferocity.
It was a low-skill floor, high mastery curve weapon, if you will.
That being said, Kaiden didn’t know which weapon he would end up preferring the most; he planned to experiment. Therefore, axes might not be his final weapon type.

And just like that, he spent 40 Chronos, or $4,000. His heart ached, but he understood this was the new world he was living in. As soon as the War Axe materialized in his hand, an ominous grin emerged on Kaiden’s lips while his eyes gleamed menacingly.
The Paragon of Sin was satisfied with his first weapon of choice.

Aria was a gentle soul who was not made for melee combat. As a result, she chose a beautiful robe that matched her silver hair and a wand. Wands and staves were the weapons of pure mages; they helped in numerous ways, such as giving bonus mana regeneration, maximum mana, faster and easier casting, etc. Aria’s was the most basic of wands, so it only helped slightly with casting, nothing more.

Luna had an innate weapon due to her spell being [Stormblade], so she could save on costs. She had to be up close and personal to make use of it, but she was much more interested in being an agile warrior than a bulky one, so she chose a light armor that fit her purple hair as it was a mix of black and purple colored.
It quickly became obvious to Kaiden that his girls paid close attention to fashion even with their armor choices. He couldn’t help but chuckle inwardly while shaking his head.
’Women...’

Since Luna retained half of her Chronos, she looked for artifacts that could supplement her on the battlefield, but they were all too expensive. Instead, she bought a low-tier potion set marketed as the ’perfect bundle for rookies,’ which ate up her remaining funds. It gave 6 vials. Two health, two mana, and two poison cure potions.

Nyx similarly went with a medium armor like Kaiden, and it was obvious to the man that the curvaceous beauty was doing her best to select a Valkyrie-like set. It was black and pink, similar to her handcrafted roleplay armor. Nyx chose a dagger for her weapon because she intended to use [Telekinesis] to manipulate her blade in the air, but she could only wield a lightweight weapon as such at a viable speed, and much to her chagrin, only one at that.
With that out of the way, it was time to go. Elysia discharged him with an amused smile as she saw they suddenly geared up and wished them the best of luck.

Nyx posted on all their platforms that Valhalla’s Sinners will be streaming their first-ever dungeon descent. They were a bit nervous to broadcast their first attempt at such a serious undertaking but thought that doing so would make them a lot more approachable. Their intention had never been to appear as supreme existences that stood above humanity. If one of them made a mistake, they would laugh alongside the viewers.

The four of them traveled to a dungeon they had scouted on the awakened platform’s forums. It was an already explored dungeon, so they could tell what to expect, which was perfect for their first time. Dungeons were ranked similarly to the tiers awakened were categorized by, but instead of tiers, dungeon difficulty was denominated by ranks.
As of now, no dungeon has ever emerged on the S-rank level.

That being said, dungeons were not to be underestimated. The Awakened Association had a recommendation for each dungeon rank. For example, a B-rank dungeon was recommended to be attempted by a well-functioning team of 10 A-tiers or an S-tier surrounded by a competent support cast. If no A-tier was present, the Awakened Association strongly advised against entry, as even a team of 50 B-tiers would suffer heavy losses. Of course, the awakened’s level also played a major role. A newly awakened S-tier supported by a competent team could not clear a B-rank dungeon at all.
"Looking for a ranger to accompany us!"
"We need a mage!"
"A porter to carry our stuff! Come, we’ll protect you!"

Numerous such shouts could be heard as some awakened were trying to form teams before entering the dungeon. Despite awakening happening almost always before 20 years of age, a lot of them seemed to be older than Kaiden.

Many of them refused to accept the reality that they were one of the lucky 15% who awakened but with a horrible class not strong enough to level up at a reasonable pace; thus, instead of going back to the non-awakened society, they wasted away in beginner dungeons. They were mockingly called the ’dreamers’ because that’s what all their aspirations were thought to be: nothing but dreams.
"Hey, can I go with you?" a sudden voice spoke up from next to Kaiden. It was a young boy, probably around 16 years old.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Dungeon Descent
paragraphs: "With us? Why? We were never in a dungeon before," Kaiden replied with surprise.
"Same... You looked competent, I thought joining you would be ideal."
Kaiden eyed the boy for a bit before shaking his head. "No, sorry. We are good as we are."

He wanted his team to consist of only his girls, at least for now. Furthermore, Kaiden definitely didn’t need baggage he would surely have to carry based on the kid’s jeans and t-shirt and surely junk-tier spear. Hence, while it might be a bit cruel, he rejected him. The boy’s smile disappeared, replaced by a desperate one, but Kaiden didn’t wait to see whether the kid would try begging him as he resumed walking toward the dungeon.
Dungeons could emerge anywhere, even inside people’s homes. When a person finds one, they are legally obligated to notify the association, who will rush to the scene and secure it.

All dungeons that formed in the territory of the USA were the government’s property, but they sold the rights to some dungeons to American guilds, who then had full ownership of them. Kaiden’s birth family, the Ashborns, owned dozens.
When one defeated the final boss, the dungeon would close a few days later, so some dungeon bosses were deliberately left alive to let the weaker guild members farm experience on the other monsters.
Naturally, this dungeon was F-ranked.

"Identifications," a guard grunted. This dungeon was owned and maintained by the association. It was one of the few dungeons they kept freely open to all who wanted to train themselves. Awakened humans were the greatest resource a country could own, so they made this investment to help poor and non-guild-associated people get a start on their leveling journeys.

Their awakened identification cards arrived during Kaiden’s two-day-long hospital stay, so they could hand them over. After doing so, the squad soon found themselves facing the swirling doorway leading to a separate dimension.

It was a mixture of white and blue, and it was wide enough for multiple people to enter at once. The other side of it was the same, but the currents on it were swirling in the other direction. This was the side where those who exited the dungeon would emerge. It stood ominously in the air, marking it as a proper warp gate.

"It’s really happening..." Nyx whispered with disbelief. The pink-haired girl was exhilarated, for she was living her dream in real-time, and it all happened because of one person... The Space Valkyrie made sure to remember she must pamper her man tonight.
"As level one existences, even the weakest monsters present a grave danger to our lives, so don’t lose focus even for a second. Let’s go," Kaiden decreed and stepped forth into the gate.

The sight that welcomed him was best described as a vast expanse of green land. This dungeon took place in a temperate forest biome, but the beginning circle didn’t have trees. It was thought to be one of the best beginner dungeons in the entire world as there were no intelligent monsters present.

Now that they were here, Kaiden started his broadcast. Aria was the only other person who streamed. As the mage of the team, she was thought to be the ideal camerawoman for those viewers who wanted the clearest viewing experience, while Kaiden would appeal to those who wanted to consume action-packed, blood-pumping content.
There was a feature that allowed them to merge the chats, so no matter which stream one watched, Kaiden would see their comments.
- Princeless Princess: I’m so excited! I wish you all the best of luck!
- Lapdog of the Empress: Handsome Emperor, offer your life to protect the Supreme Empress. No harm must come her way, understood?!
- Shadow Warrior: I already grabbed the popcorn. Give me a good show.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Kaiiiiiiiiiiii! I loved the nurse video and even paid for the full content! I never thought it would happen, but I’m pretty sure I just found my celeb crush...
- Corn Addict: Wait, why is the clarity so good? I saw some... ehem... videos of ChronosX, and their first-person cameras weren’t as good, not at all.
Numerous people started joining in, but Kaiden ignored the comments.
The farther one ventured from the dungeon gate, the stronger encounters they could expect. This was why they intended to stay in the green fields close to the gate.
This dungeon was a public one in the sense that numerous parties could enter, thus, they could see some groups in the middle of battle while other teams were strategizing or taking a breather.
It didn’t take them more than a minute of walking to chance upon a monster.
Dungeon monsters were unique; even the ones that looked like animals were supernatural entities, such as the boar in front of them.
"Wait, what the hell?!" Kaiden shouted in shock after he paused the stream, and he did so with Aria’s as well.
His eyes could see some information above it.
<Razor Warthog - Level 1>
"Ah! I see it too, Kai!" Aria gasped.
"This is so cool!" Luna cheered.
Seeing the level of monsters was not at all normal.

[The Supreme Demonic Sovereign System was created by the Heavenly Demon to assist him. The system lost most of its original functions when the Heavenly Demon reconstructed it before his defeat, but it did retain some of the more basic functions.]

’I won’t look a gift horse in the mouth. Thanks, Celestial Tyrant, very cool of you,’ Kaiden noted inwardly before moving on, "Who wants to do the honors?" He thought ganging up on a single, level one pig would be too much.
"It should be you, Kai!"
"Yeah, I think you deserve it for what you’ve done for us," Luna nodded in agreement.

"The master should get the first kill, obviously, but as his dutiful angels, we should move close just in case he needs backup," Nyx voiced her opinion, which earned a scoff from Luna and pink cheeks from Aria.

Kaiden knew from experience his camera skill was not recording stuff like his awakened platform, thus, he should be good on this front. The viewers couldn’t see the things his system showed him, as, in reality, it happened in his head only. However, he could summon his system’s messages for others to read, at which point they would most certainly get recorded, so he had to be careful on that front.
The stream resumed.
"Mode: Wrath."

Kaiden intoned the keyword to enter his sin stance as he gripped his big War Axe and began approaching the boar. "Apologies for the brief pause; a tactical discussion took place. The first-ever dungeon descent of Valhalla’s Sinners officially begins now."
The monster looked like a normal warthog, save for its longer and sharper tusks, as well as the razor-like fur on its back.
After recognizing the approaching danger, it huffed, kicked the dirt with its hooves, and began aggressively charging at the squad with an unnatural force, propelling it forward at great speeds.

’A charging ability, huh? What else could you expect from a dumb piggy?’ Kaiden thought inwardly before he planted both of his feet firmly on the ground, gripped the handle of his axe, and aimed its pointy end at the charging beast, ready to impale it using its own velocity to his advantage.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: First Monster Encounter
paragraphs: Things didn’t exactly happen as Kaiden expected them to. The warthog’s hide and skull were so strong that the monster sustained their clash without getting injured. According to his logic, its brain should’ve been pierced by his axe’s spear-like end by now.

Since no such event occurred, Kaiden now found himself in a mighty power struggle against a wild monsterized beast. The razor warthog glared at him with eyes full of fury, using its robust muscles to push him back. Kaiden’s grip tightened around his axe’s handle as he met the monster’s challenge head-on.
"Gh!" he grunted from the physical exertion while gritting his teeth. His muscles ached, and multiple veins of his popped.
While this was going on, three pairs of eyes stared at him wryly.’Men...’the ladies thought in sync.

"You...! Win....!" Kaiden decreed with much difficulty before pulling his weapon back and stepping out of its way. The warthog monster resumed its charge, but no one was in front of it. Kaiden snickered at the dumb monster as he raised his axe high above his head and brought it down. "[Doom Strike]!"
He hit the charging boar in the behind because it had already shot past him. A guttural, pained cry erupted from the beast before it started limping.

Its fight-or-flight response kicked in as it started running for the woods visible in the distance. "I don’t think so..." Kaiden muttered with hungrily burning red eyes, dashing after his prey. Another two hits did the job.
[You’ve slain a razor warthog (Level 1). You’ve gained 30 XP.]

This was the standard way one could tell the level of their enemy. More experienced combatants could also estimate the level of their opponent from contextual clues or the strength and abilities displayed while fighting. Some artifacts and spells were also capable of measuring enemy strength, but none were as transparent and convenient as the system. Kaiden just had to look at the monsters, and the level was displayed immediately. Sadly, it didn’t work on humans.

Nearly a thousand viewers saw the killing taking place in real time. The chat spurred awake as messages of congratulations came rushing in, though a lot were also diminishing the achievement, saying this was just a beginner dungeon and a dumb beast-type monster at that. A fight rapidly ensued between a few chatters.

The dead monster bled profusely like a normal creature, but upon its death, it started losing color and became hollow before disappearing completely. Dead monsters were despawned while inside the dungeons. If a dungeon break occurred, meaning the monsters left the dungeon’s dimension and entered Earth, or they were dragged out alive, monster corpses would remain.
"I think I’m going to puke," Aria announced with a matter-of-fact tone. Her face was pale due to the brutality of Kaiden’s method of killing the creature.

Strangely, Kaiden himself felt nothing, as if what he’d done was completely normal. He didn’t know if he should be concerned by his lack of disgust and concern, but honestly, Kaiden was happy not having to face such issues.

Nyx had a similar reaction to him. She was technically training to become an awakened for a decade, and she was also a Scarlet fangirl who saw numerous videos featuring her burning monsters alive, so she was very prepared mentally.
Luna was in the middle of the two ends; she felt discomfort but was good to go.

"Here’s some sugar. It’ll help," Kaiden said while approaching his gorgeous Moon Valkyrie after grabbing a chocolate bar from his backpack. The group brought some essentials with them, ready to combat the most common challenges awakened face in dungeons.
"I want a hug instead!" Aria decreed and, without waiting for a response, dove into his embrace.
While the pair needily hugged each other, Nyx approached Luna. "I can’t help but notice that the princess has been very actively occupying Kai’s attention recently."
"You don’t need to tell me... The princess is scared, sure, but she’s overplaying it. Kaiden, as expected, fell for her act—hook, line, and sinker."
"What do you plan to do?" Nyx inquired curiously.
Luna shrugged her shoulders dismissively. "Nothing. I’m not such a needy person to stoop this low to get his attention. I’ll just slay some monsters and out-level the princess before long."
"Playing the long game, huh? Smart."
"Are you okay?" Kaiden asked as he lay a kiss on top of Aria’s head. She slowly detached herself from his arms and nodded while looking up at him with teary eyes. "Yes, thank you... I’m sorry."
"Don’t worry about it. You’ll get used to it before long."
The silver-haired girl nodded once again, and the group moved along.
"Oh, what a beautiful animal!" Aria squealed with wonder as two large, majestic deer-like monsters became visible in the far distance.
<Overgrown Stag - Level 1>
<Overgrown Stag - Level 2>
"I’m afraid we’ll be killing them..." Kaiden replied wryly to Aria’s innocent exclamation.

She eyed the gorgeous creatures with a pained gaze before steeling her resolve. These were monsters that would attack them until either party died. There was no such thing as a pacifist monster unless they were intelligent. Elves, for example, were well-known for not attacking unless one ventured deep into their territories, and even then, they often gave a warning before attacking. In this dungeon, there were no intelligent creatures—each monster was instinctively out for human blood.
"Let’s work together to bring them down," Nyx whispered as they all started sneaking closer.
"Yes, you and Aria should start this scuffle off with a ranged attack," Luna agreed.

"What’s your range?" Nyx asked, but Aria, of course, didn’t know. She had never shot her spell before as she had no chance to. "Ah, yes, sorry. Mine is relatively short, we’ll have to move closer," Nyx added once she recognized her mistake.

As the squad got closer and closer, it quickly became apparent why these beasts were called overgrown; they were twice as large as normal stags out in the wilds. Nyx’s plan was foiled when the monsters became aware of their presence even before they reached the halfway point of her range. "Aria, aim calmly and shoot one of them," Kaiden instructed as he stood from his crouched position, readying his axe.

The stags immediately started charging at them. Luna put her two arms forward while making a grabbing motion as if she had a transparent blade in her hand, and then intoned her Storm Valkyrie spell. "[Stormblade]!"
*zzzt-CRACK!*
A soft sizzle marked the arrival of her spell before a loud crack of lightning reverberated all across the battlefield. It sounded incredibly threatening.

A blade of constantly convulsing energies materialized in her hand. Luna flinched and almost dropped it but managed to hold things together. Her fright was understandable, as miniature lightning strikes constantly went off in the miniature storms surrounding her blade. Despite the blade being of hostile elements, it didn’t injure its rightful holder. Luna’s surprise quickly turned into gleeful satisfaction. This was a badass spell for a badass girl like her, a perfect match, she thought. These violent energies would help her slay her enemies.

"[Telekinesis]." Nyx was a lot more practiced because her spell could be used in a civilian setting. As such, she diligently trained ever since getting her class. She used her mental powers to grab her dagger from its sheath and aim it at the charging beasts. It floated in the air seamlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Power of the Valkyries
paragraphs: Aria collected her thoughts in time to aim her wand at the slightly bigger beast, the one that was level 2, and she intoned, "[Lunar Arc]!" Her spell immediately erupted from the edge of her wand and shot towards the beast. It was slightly slower than David’s Arcane Bolt, but its destructive potential seemed to be a lot higher.

The shimmering white projectile followed a crescent shape. At first, it seemed the spell would miss its target due to the curve, but the projectile returned in time to hit the monster on its side. The stag monster howled in pain while staggering back. Blood quickly began pouring from its ugly wound.

The other stag ignored its ally’s suffering and continued its charge relentlessly. "You’re mine!" Nyx decreed with a sadistic smile just before she moved her dagger slightly lower in the air and aimed it at the giant stag’s chest.

This monster was not a complete brute like the razor warthog. It elegantly jumped to the side once a clear threat to its safety was detected and continued its charge. However, Nyx’s spell was incredibly versatile. She was not deterred by the enemy’s dodge—she aimed the dagger at its lower neck and pushed with all her mental might.

The sharp blade penetrated the hide of the monster, eliciting a guttural scream. "Again..." Nyx whispered excitedly. She was deeply absorbed in her battle; this spell required tremendous focus from her to function well. With a slight lapse of focus, she would lose control, and the dagger would unceremoniously fall to the ground.
The Space Valkyrie pulled the knife from the wound and aimed again.
*Stab! Stab! Stab!*

The horrible, distinct sound of a sharp object tearing flesh and muscle apart sounded over and over again as Nyx mercilessly repeated the same action. She wasn’t just ready to shed blood—she washereto shed blood. A cruel smile erupted on her features upon observing the rapidly flowing red fountain emerge from the monster as a direct result of her handiwork.
The creature lost the ability to control its large body due to the heavy loss of blood it suffered, thus, it fell to the side helplessly. Its body couldn’t continue.
"Amazing!" Nyx bellowed with utmost satisfaction in her voice as she removed the dagger from the creature and went for the mercy kill.
"[Lunar Arc]." Aria aimed her spell again and hit the level 2 stag as soon as her spell came off cooldown. It stopped its struggle.

Kaiden and Luna were flabbergasted. They didn’t expect these two to have so much firepower. Nyx’s control over her [Telekinesis] was heavily improved compared to the time she gave Kaiden a telekinetic handjob. She could move the dagger with great velocity.

Meanwhile, Aria’s spell was simply a heavy-hitting, long-ranged attack that, due to its form, had the potential to hit multiple enemies along the crescent shape the projectile took. It also had a short cooldown of 8 seconds.

"Did you see that?" Kaiden could hear someone nearby exclaim in shock. A pair of combatants were in the middle of a tactical analysis when they saw these four strangers fail to sneak up on the stags. As such, they came closer, thinking these obvious rookies might need to be saved, but it turned out that...

"They must be at least D-tier... man, fuck this shit. I wish I just stayed a normie. Being lucky enough to awaken but unlucky enough to get a useless class is worse than not awakening in the first place..." A man in his mid-twenties grumbled.
"Hey, you’re doing good, Nort. Didn’t you just hit level 5?" the woman next to him replied in a compassionate tone.
"Yeah, and it only took me what? 3 years? I should stop being a dreamer. I’m wasting my life away like this... My father’s pub could use a waiter," he sighed with dejection.
"I guess..."
"How about you come with me, Monica?"

"Sure! Let’s get married while we’re at it," the woman announced, shocking the man greatly. The pair then started walking toward the dungeon gate after tossing their weapons to the side. They were clearly junk-tier and very used at that.
Two desperate men immediately rushed to the site and started a fistfight over the ownership of the items.
Fighting inside the dungeon was prohibited by the association, but there was a workaround. These two were teammates, so the rules didn’t apply.
Kaiden couldn’t help but chuckle while shaking his head. Some of these dreamers were certified weirdos.
However, he had to agree with the engaged (?) pair about one thing: these spells were not at all F-tier worthy.
They were simple, yes, but had great potential. The only thing he could think of was that the girls only had one spell to their names, hence the F-tier rating.

But there should be a limit to that rule. If one started with only a single spell, but it was [Nuclear Blast], there was no way they would be put in F-tier. The fact the girls’ power level had the same reading as him also alluded to the fact that some weird fuckery was going on.’Things will become clear with time...’Kaiden told himself while moving on.
"Well, that was disappointing as hell..." Luna grumbled as she dispelled her weapon.
"Sorry!" Aria apologized with a bow of her head.

"Don’t apologize to this woman, princess. She will become our resident kill-stealer, I can already tell," Nyx replied slyly, earning a warm smile from Luna, wordlessly conveying, ’I’ll most certainly steal your kills, bitch’.

"Sister! I finally found you!" a sudden voice shouted. A man was rushing toward them. He was wearing proper awakened armor, unlike the ones the dreamers and other rookies tended to wear in this dungeon. Even Kaiden and co stood out with their pristine new common rarity gear, but the man’s was on another level entirely.
Luna’s features immediately lost their color when she turned her head and was confronted by her elder brother’s visage. "Theo...?" she whispered with a voice full of worry, disbelief, and pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Meeting Theodore
paragraphs: Kaiden, Aria, and Nyx all tensed upon hearing Luna’s words. They knew perfectly well what this man did to her. Theodore was the sole reason Luna went to the adult filming studio on that day, he forced her hand.
"Sister! You don’t know how much I’ve been searching for you!" the man shouted. His voice was full of joy and relief.
"That’s close enough," Kaiden decreed as he stepped between his delicate lover and her brother.
Theodore’s features immediately contorted as he glanced at Kaiden. "Who are you?"
"Her boyfriend."

The man’s grimace lessened and soon returned to his joyous state. "That’s amazing! Nice to meet you. I’m Theo, Luna’s elder brother." Having said his greetings, he extended his right hand for a handshake.
Kaiden didn’t accept it. "How did you find us?"
"..." Theodore eyed his right hand, which was gripping his axe’s handle, refusing to shake his offered hand. "My guildmate told me he saw my sister enter this dungeon, so I rushed to the scene."

’Does that mean he’s not aware I’m streaming this conversation? There’s also something very wrong with this dude,’Kaiden thought inwardly. Theodore acted as if he’d done nothing wrong and was a good brother to Luna. Kaiden was not the only one who noticed this.
"What do you want?! I still have time to pay this month’s quota!" Luna shouted, she was mightily struggling with her emotions.
Theodore shook his head. "I’m sorry about all that, sister. It was a grave mistake on my end, you don’t owe me anything. Do you have it in you to forgive me?"

Luna’s face told Kaiden that a million thoughts were swirling in her distraught mind right now. Theodore was the last member of her family. As a result, Luna wanted to forgive him, but she also understood he had done something truly unforgivable—something a loving brother would never do to his little sister.

"A mistake?! Forgive you?! You forced me to earn $5,000 a month or else you would do unspeakable things to me!" Luna yelled from the top of her lungs. It seemed the part of her brain that couldn’t let things go just like this won out in the end.

Theodore winced at the fury his sister held for him. Things were not going as he’d hoped. "Sister, I’m ready to do anything to earn your forgiveness. Should I kneel in front of you and beg? Yes, I’ll do just that," he stated and got to his knees.

Kaiden distinctly remembered Luna saying the only way she would ever forgive him was if he did exactly this. However, all four of them felt that this man was ’off.’ He was not being genuine, or at least there was more to it.
"Stop! Stand up and stop calling me your sister. Turn around and leave us alone," the Storm Valkyrie instructed her brother in a cold, determined tone.

Theodore wasn’t willing to comply. "Listen to me, Luna. We can make everything right again. I didn’t know you had awakened, but as soon as I heard the news, I secured you a spot in my guild. We can reach for the stars together!"
"???" At this point, even Luna was utterly lost. "What makes you think I want to be your guildmate?!"

"I understand you’re furious with me, and for a good reason at that, but think about it! You’re wasting your time with this amateur party of yours. In the Blood Pact, we have our separate dungeons for training! Older and more experienced people are ready to guide you every step of your learning. You won’t have to risk your life every time you enter battle, unlike how it is when you party with guildless rookies!"

Hearing Theodore’s words, Luna’s expression turned hostile. She didn’t like how he referred to her friends and lover. With a low, determined tone, Luna replied, "I’m perfectly happy with my current arrangements, thank you. The only thing that could make my day better is you turning around and leaving us alone."

Seeing his words weren’t taking him anywhere, Theodore underwent a sudden change. His youthful features disappeared as a tired, depressed man replaced the youthful warrior. The change was so abrupt that they thought some magic was at play here. "Please, listen, Luna... My one and only remaining family member... I desperately need your help... Please, join the guild with me!"
"What the hell is wrong with you?" Kaiden growled while readying his weapon.

"Now we’re finally getting somewhere!" Luna shouted before announcing her findings, "When I was a commoner, you saw me as either an ATM or a pretty doll to curry favor with your bosses. But now that I’m awakened, you’d receive better rewards by recruiting me!"
"Don’t say it like that... Your friends and boyfriend can come with us too!"

Luna shook her head, finding it difficult to continue this talk. Her tender heart was visibly suffering. She lowered her voice, whispering dejectedly, "Theo, what happened to you? I remember you as a bright and kind big brother, but you’re akin to a delusional lunatic right now. When you awakened to your class, I thought our lives would turn for the better, but the exact opposite happened."
The man looked at the ground with great sorrow written all over his face. "The Blood Pact... They scouted me and offered a deal I couldn’t refuse..."
"I don’t know what to say. I can’t help you. Go to the Awakened Association and report these shady sons of bitches if they’re doing something illegal."

It took Theodore a few seconds to garner a response, and when he did, his features once again transformed, now looking much more sinister than ever before. "I’m sorry, but my hand is forced. You’ll be joining whether you like it or not. When one brings in their full-blooded relatives, they get much better treatment. Both of our lives will become greater. You’ll see that this was the best choice I could make given my circumstances."

He then made a sudden dash toward Luna. Kaiden stepped in between them, slashing with his axe. However, Theodore was much faster than he expected—easily dodging Kaiden’s attack, he zig-zagged to go around him, after which he grabbed onto Luna’s waist and hoisted her over his shoulder. Kaiden knew Theodore was a B-tier combatant who awakened less than a month ago, but based on his displayed speed, he must’ve been at least level 5.

Kaiden aimed his hand at Theodore to shoot him with his fire spell, [Fiery Burst], but stopped because it would also hit Luna, who would most likely die as a result. Instead, he rushed after them using his [Warpath] spell. "Nyx!"

"[Telekinesis]!" the Space Valkyrie was quickly brought out of her daze due to his shout and aimed her dagger at the escaping man. Her power was too weak for now to directly affect living organisms, so she couldn’t hold him in place.
"Let me down! You fucking piece of shit!" Luna struggled against her kidnapper, but her meager physical stats were low even for level 1 standards, so she had no chance. "[Stormblade]!"

"I can’t have you do that," Theodore decreed while he easily dodged Nyx’s dagger as if he had an eye on the back of his head. He brought a syringe out of his pocket and injected his sister with its contents, which caused her spell to not go off. She lost access to her mana.
"What the?!" Luna shouted while doing her utmost to free herself.
"This serum only works on those that don’t have 20 Vitality. Don’t worry, sister; you’ll be able to cast spells again in an hour or so."
"What is your plan?! There’s only one exit, and you will be taken into custody by the guards as soon as you step out!"

A sudden, manic cackling sounded from Theodore’s lips. "Hahaha! That’s right! What if we were to live on the outskirts of this dungeon? No one ventures that far in; we can exist there in peace as loving siblings! No more Blood Pact, no more threats, no more begging... It sounds like a dream come true."

"You’ve gone crazy! Put me down!" Luna wasn’t having whatever nonsense her brother was spouting. She never paused her fruitless resistance even for a second, but Theodore didn’t react even when she hit him in the head.
Meanwhile, Kaiden, Aria, and Nyx were doing their best to catch up to the speedy man.
