"My guildmate told me he saw my sister enter this dungeon, so I rushed to the scene."
’Does that mean he’s not aware I’m streaming this conversation?
There’s also something very wrong with this dude,’Kaiden thought inwardly.
Theodore acted as if he’d done nothing wrong and was a good brother to Luna.
Kaiden was not the only one who noticed this.
"What do you want?!
I still have time to pay this month’s quota!" Luna shouted, she was mightily struggling with her emotions.
Theodore shook his head.
"I’m sorry about all that, sister.
It was a grave mistake on my end, you don’t owe me anything.
Do you have it in you to forgive me?"
Luna’s face told Kaiden that a million thoughts were swirling in her distraught mind right now.
Theodore was the last member of her family.
As a result, Luna wanted to forgive him, but she also understood he had done something truly unforgivable—something a loving brother would never do to his little sister.
"A mistake?!
Forgive you?!
You forced me to earn $5,000 a month or else you would do unspeakable things to me!" Luna yelled from the top of her lungs.
It seemed the part of her brain that couldn’t let things go just like this won out in the end.
Theodore winced at the fury his sister held for him.
Things were not going as he’d hoped.
"Sister, I’m ready to do anything to earn your forgiveness.
Should I kneel in front of you and beg?
Yes, I’ll do just that," he stated and got to his knees.
Kaiden distinctly remembered Luna saying the only way she would ever forgive him was if he did exactly this.
However, all four of them felt that this man was ’off.’ He was not being genuine, or at least there was more to it.
"Stop!
Stand up and stop calling me your sister.
Turn around and leave us alone," the Storm Valkyrie instructed her brother in a cold, determined tone.
Theodore wasn’t willing to comply.
"Listen to me, Luna.
We can make everything right again.
I didn’t know you had awakened, but as soon as I heard the news, I secured you a spot in my guild.
We can reach for the stars together!"
"???" At this point, even Luna was utterly lost.
"What makes you think I want to be your guildmate?!"
"I understand you’re furious with me, and for a good reason at that, but think about it!
You’re wasting your time with this amateur party of yours.
In the Blood Pact, we have our separate dungeons for training!
Older and more experienced people are ready to guide you every step of your learning.
You won’t have to risk your life every time you enter battle, unlike how it is when you party with guildless rookies!"
Hearing Theodore’s words, Luna’s expression turned hostile.
She didn’t like how he referred to her friends and lover.
With a low, determined tone, Luna replied, "I’m perfectly happy with my current arrangements, thank you.
The only thing that could make my day better is you turning around and leaving us alone."
Seeing his words weren’t taking him anywhere, Theodore underwent a sudden change.
His youthful features disappeared as a tired, depressed man replaced the youthful warrior.
The change was so abrupt that they thought some magic was at play here.
"Please, listen, Luna...
My one and only remaining family member...
I desperately need your help...
Please, join the guild with me!"
"What the hell is wrong with you?" Kaiden growled while readying his weapon.
"Now we’re finally getting somewhere!" Luna shouted before announcing her findings, "When I was a commoner, you saw me as either an ATM or a pretty doll to curry favor with your bosses.
But now that I’m awakened, you’d receive better rewards by recruiting me!"
"Don’t say it like that...
Your friends and boyfriend can come with us too!"
Luna shook her head, finding it difficult to continue this talk.
Her tender heart was visibly suffering.
She lowered her voice, whispering dejectedly, "Theo, what happened to you?
I remember you as a bright and kind big brother, but you’re akin to a delusional lunatic right now.
When you awakened to your class, I thought our lives would turn for the better, but the exact opposite happened."
The man looked at the ground with great sorrow written all over his face.
"The Blood Pact...
They scouted me and offered a deal I couldn’t refuse..."
"I don’t know what to say.
I can’t help you.
Go to the Awakened Association and report these shady sons of bitches if they’re doing something illegal."
It took Theodore a few seconds to garner a response, and when he did, his features once again transformed, now looking much more sinister than ever before.
"I’m sorry, but my hand is forced.
You’ll be joining whether you like it or not.
When one brings in their full-blooded relatives, they get much better treatment.
Both of our lives will become greater.
You’ll see that this was the best choice I could make given my circumstances."
He then made a sudden dash toward Luna.
Kaiden stepped in between them, slashing with his axe.
However, Theodore was much faster than he expected—easily dodging Kaiden’s attack, he zig-zagged to go around him, after which he grabbed onto Luna’s waist and hoisted her over his shoulder.
Kaiden knew Theodore was a B-tier combatant who awakened less than a month ago, but based on his displayed speed, he must’ve been at least level 5.
Kaiden aimed his hand at Theodore to shoot him with his fire spell, [Fiery Burst], but stopped because it would also hit Luna, who would most likely die as a result.
Instead, he rushed after them using his [Warpath] spell.
"Nyx!"
"[Telekinesis]!" the Space Valkyrie was quickly brought out of her daze due to his shout and aimed her dagger at the escaping man.
Her power was too weak for now to directly affect living organisms, so she couldn’t hold him in place.
"Let me down!
You fucking piece of shit!" Luna struggled against her kidnapper, but her meager physical stats were low even for level 1 standards, so she had no chance.
"[Stormblade]!"
"I can’t have you do that," Theodore decreed while he easily dodged Nyx’s dagger as if he had an eye on the back of his head.
He brought a syringe out of his pocket and injected his sister with its contents, which caused her spell to not go off.
She lost access to her mana.
"What the?!" Luna shouted while doing her utmost to free herself.
"This serum only works on those that don’t have 20 Vitality.
Don’t worry, sister; you’ll be able to cast spells again in an hour or so."
"What is your plan?!
There’s only one exit, and you will be taken into custody by the guards as soon as you step out!"
A sudden, manic cackling sounded from Theodore’s lips.
"Hahaha!
That’s right!
What if we were to live on the outskirts of this dungeon?
No one ventures that far in; we can exist there in peace as loving siblings!
No more Blood Pact, no more threats, no more begging...
It sounds like a dream come true."
"You’ve gone crazy!
Put me down!" Luna wasn’t having whatever nonsense her brother was spouting.
She never paused her fruitless resistance even for a second, but Theodore didn’t react even when she hit him in the head.
Meanwhile, Kaiden, Aria, and Nyx were doing their best to catch up to the speedy man.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Giving Chase
paragraphs: Theodore was much faster than the girls, and even Kaiden was outpaced despite his sprinting ability; thus, the distance between pursuer and pursued only grew with each passing second despite their best efforts.
<Rabid Forest Rat - Level 3>

Four of such creatures attacked him from the sides all of a sudden. Their fur was the color of the forest, and they were as big as a medium-sized dog. One of the dumb beasts jumped in front of him, getting blown away by his charge ability just as its duration ended. The monster was sent flying a good distance, swatted away by pure mass and velocity alone.
’I don’t have time for this!’Kaiden yelled inwardly as he readied his weapon. "[Doom Strike]!"
He was much more clinical in his approach than he was with the warthog. Back then, that creature was a curious enemy to study and slay, but now, these rats were just annoying obstacles in his path.

Despite them being higher level, they were inferior to the pig when it came to defense because the warthog’s sturdy natural exterior protected it as if it were armor. Kaiden swung his axe in a horizontal arc, injuring two in the process. Instead of bleeding red, the liquid leaving their body was a vile, putrid green that hissed and smoked as it hit the ground.
"[Fiery Burst]!" he intoned at the rats writhing around on the ground in pain. The one who wasn’t hit by his strike managed to dodge to the side, but the two injured ones were burned alive.
[You’ve slain Rabid Forest Rat (Level 3). You’ve gained 100 XP.]
[You’ve slain Rabid Forest Rat (Level 3). You’ve gained 100 XP.]
"Kai, don’t move! [Lunar Arc]!" Aria shouted as she finally managed to catch up. The third rat was hit by her projectile and finished off by Nyx’s dagger. Kaiden quickly beheaded the last one.
He glanced at Theodore’s shrinking form in the far distance and cursed furiously. His Agility stat was simply too low to keep up, but he refused to give up.
- Princeless Princess: I already called the association! They should be on the way!
- Kaiden’s Wife: Kai, you should remain where you are and wait for the association! It’s too dangerous to continue!
- Failed Writer: Bro this shit is straight-up better than a Hollywood movie. This can’t be scripted, right?
- Weasel: I’m sure it’s scripted. Though the kidnapper’s acting is very good, he should get an Oscar for managing to display such a truly disturbed man so perfectly.

The stream was gaining momentum as more and more people tuned in, however, Kaiden wasn’t in the mood to care about viewer numbers right now. His girl had been taken away from him by a lunatic. Her life was in danger.

They were a good ten minutes from the dungeon’s entrance, meaning it was likely going to take some time for help to arrive, and that’s assuming the association wouldn’t wait to ascertain the validity of the callers and their statements, thinking them to be trolls.

Furthermore, the association might not mobilize the guards who are standing just outside the gate to rush after the kidnapper instead of securing the exit, for example. It might be a while until help arrives.
"I’m going to go after Luna. We don’t know how long it’ll take for help to get here."
"I’m coming with you!"
"So am I!"
Neither of the girls wished to remain behind.
Kaiden nodded his acceptance before resuming the chase. He couldn’t afford to keep wasting time.

"The farther we go from the dungeon’s entrance, the stronger the enemies...!" Nyx reminded them while panting heavily. She was the least fit of the three, so she was getting left behind by Aria and Kaiden, who could sprint well. Her medium armor also wasn’t doing her any favors.

The trio continued as such for another few minutes, during which they were ambushed by low-level monsters twice. Then, Kaiden abruptly stopped. "Let’s take a breather," he said while reaching for his backpack and handing each of them a bottle of water. The two Valkyries were looking at him with confusion.

Seeing their perplexed gazes, Kaiden explained his thoughts. "We can’t keep going like this—we’ll just get ourselves killed. Theodore is facing more monsters than we are because he is in the front. We can track him using the trail of corpses he leaves behind."
"I see. Doing so will also allow us to try leveling up before the clash," Nyx noted her observations.
Kaiden nodded. "Exactly. Theodore will become tired soon enough. Let’s continue the pursuit at our own pace, conserving our stamina."
"I’m proud of you, Kai! You kept your emotions in check despite the severity of the situation," Aria stated with a tender smile while stroking Kaiden’s arm tenderly.
"If it was just me, I probably would’ve rushed after them until my legs fell off, but I have to protect you two, too."
Nyx had a dejected look on her beautiful face. "I’m sorry, guys... If only I took better care of my body, I wouldn’t drag you two down."
"The two of us were getting outran too. Don’t blame yourself for no reason," Kaiden replied.

Despite his comforting words, the pink-haired beauty wasn’t keen to take the easy way out. Her downcast eyes transformed into determined ones. "I’ll take my body’s battle readiness seriously from now on! Princess, please help me when we get out of this situation." As a trainer, Aria was as good a candidate as any to help Nyx bolster her fitness.

When one leveled up, their stats would increase; thus, their basic stats mattered less and less the higher leveled they became. However, in Nyx’s opinion, every single stat point was a priceless gem for combatants. As such, she steeled her resolve to improve her base stats even if doing so would be a difficult undertaking—she was not a big fan of salads and sweating.
"Sure!" Her request was accepted with utmost joy evident in Aria’s features.
Kaiden glanced at his status window and saw he had 897 XP out of the 1000 needed to reach level 2. "How are you girls with XP?"
"I need a little over 300 XP to level up."
"Me too. The issue is that my mana reserves are dwindling..."
"It’s okay. Try to be conservative with your mana, I’ll act as frontline. You two should wait for the perfect moment to launch your attacks."
Aria and Nyx nodded in understanding, and they resumed their tense journey to save Luna from her mentally deranged brother.
It did not take long for the trio to reach the edge of the forest. It was a dungeon set in a forest biome, after all. Only the starting area was in the open fields.
"Finding his trail will take even more time and effort now..." Kaiden grumbled, but such a turn of events was within his expectations.
*Grrrrrr!* After a single minute of trekking through the dense forest foliage, a deep, guttural growl sounded.
<Silverback Mauler - Level 5>
Kaiden only had a moment to read the monster’s information before a large bear-like creature pounced on him from the bushes with so much speed that he couldn’t even react in time.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Silverback Mauler
paragraphs: "[Lunar Arc]!"
"[Telekinesis]!"
Aria and Nyx hurriedly intoned their spells just as the bear-like monster used its strong limbs to swipe at Kaiden with its muscular, clawed paws.
His Metal Nomad armor set took the brunt of the hit for him, but he was still sent flying due to the sheer force exerted by the silverback mauler.
Not only did every level bring stats up a good amount, but a monster’s difficulty greatly varied depending on its race. A level 100 dragon would be a lot mightier than a level 100 goblin.

This silverback creature was not a simpleton like the warthog and the stags who could only charge with their heads down, bracing for impact. It was also protected by its heavy, sturdy hide, unlike the rats. Nyx’s dagger and Aria’s projectile failed to injure the beast in any significant manner.
As level one existences, they were in grave danger. The mauler was tankier, stronger, faster, and enjoying the comfort and familiarity of its natural habitat.

Kaiden groaned with extreme amounts of pain coursing through his injured body, but he forced himself to stand up—he knew very well he was the only one who could face this creature in melee range. If its focus was directed at his girls, they would not live to tell the tale.
’Against a physically superior monster, you have to use your abilities to your advantage. If that doesn’t work, you’re left with relying on your superior intellect. Outsmart it.’

Kaiden remembered back to his mother’s words when he watched Alice train with her—which almost always resulted in his little sister getting beaten up mercilessly. Alice would often spend hours afterward crying into his shirt.
Now that Kaiden thought about Alice, he couldn’t help but compare his feelings toward his younger sister versus the atrocity that was Theodore’s feelings regarding Luna.
As a result of doing so, Kaiden felt more and more enraged with every passing moment.

A big brother was meant to protect, to be the shield that would sustain injuries so that their weak siblings wouldn’t have to. Yet, this failure of a brother tracked them down just to offer Luna to his sketchy organization’s bosses or whatever his plan was.

The mere thought made Kaiden’s blood boil. He understood the world was an ugly place, but since getting to know his girls and their horrible stories, Kaiden was forced to stare these living human scum in the face instead of hearing about them through the net.
He wanted nothing more than to tear Theodore from limb to limb. To listen to his pained cries while begging for mercy that would never come. However, the target of his rage was nowhere in sight.
But the silverback mauler was.

Kaiden eyed the creature with fiery red eyes. The Paragon of Sin instinctively knew he wasn’t strong enough to cut through the bear with his axe blade. The pick end of it was a different story, though. It allowed the force of his strike to converge at a single point.
He ignored his body’s begging for him to run for his life and dashed back into the fray.
"Aim for its eyes!" Kaiden shouted while turning his axe handle around in his palm.

His loud voice grabbed the monster’s attention, and it once again pounced at him. The mauler’s sharp combat instincts marked Kaiden as the biggest threat to its life. Kaiden knew he couldn’t match the beast in speed, nor could he take another major hit, so all he could do was keep a steady distance between the two of them to the best of his abilities.
It swiped its mighty claws at him, but he was ready and managed to step back just in time.

"[Lunar Arc]!" Aria intoned while aiming her wand right at the creature’s left eye. However, the silverback monster dodged the projectile and used its momentum to strike at Kaiden’s frame. Kaiden’s [Adaptive Reflexes] passive skill was starting to kick in as he saw the attack coming at him, but due to the Agility stat difference between the two, he was not able to dodge. On the bright side, he was quick enough to raise his gauntleted hand to protect himself.
*Bam!*

Kaiden gritted his teeth as the claws nearly severed his arm. The only reason it remained intact was the existence of his metal gauntlet, which was in a completely ruined state after sustaining just one strike.

However, he couldn’t afford to care right now. The copious amount of adrenaline coursing through his veins came in clutch when Kaiden gripped the axe handle with both arms and swung it at the beast. He hit it in the shoulder and left a severe puncture wound in its place.
Kaiden knew he had to create distance between himself and the monster, or he’d have no chance of dodging its next attack.
The monster roared with pain, rising to its two legs in a threatening manner, towering over the tall Kaiden by many heads.

Nyx remained patient throughout the fight. She watched with a heavy heart as the man she cherished sustained ugly wounds, but the Space Valkyrie forced herself to bide her time. She knew that waiting for the perfect moment to strike was their best chance at victory while panicking would doom both her friend and lover to fall here.
When the beast got on its two hind legs and started roaring, her patience was rewarded at long last. Nyx used her telekinetic powers to stab its right eye by utilizing all her mental power.

The might of the monster’s guttural roar lessened, turning into a pained cry. It got down on four legs once again, using its paw to pull the dagger out. It had to do so because Nyx kept twisting the dagger in its eye socket, causing extreme pain.
All three combatants knew perfectly well:
It was now or never.
Despite the severity of the eye injury, the beast would manage to get over it soon enough.

When the beast got on its two hind legs and started roaring, her patience was rewarded at long last.
Nyx used her telekinetic powers to stab its right eye by utilizing all her mental power.
The might of the monster’s guttural roar lessened, turning into a pained cry.
It got down on four legs once again, using its paw to pull the dagger out.
It had to do so because Nyx kept twisting the dagger in its eye socket, causing extreme pain.
All three combatants knew perfectly well:
It was now or never.
Despite the severity of the eye injury, the beast would manage to get over it soon enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Combined Assault
paragraphs: "[Lunar Arc]!" Aria intoned while aiming at the bleeding eye socket that Nyx’s masterful assault had left behind.
"[Doom Strike]!" Kaiden jumped at the monster, swinging his War Axe with all his might.
Nyx was in the middle of conducting a power struggle against the mauler as it refused to let go of her dagger, keeping it under its left paw.
Aria’s projectile hit its mark, driving deep into the monster’s eye socket. The moon-themed spell pushed through and left a severe wound on its skull. Copious amounts of blood gushed forth.

Kaiden’s follow-up came at the perfect time. He gritted his teeth and gripped the handle so tightly that numerous veins popped on his arm. The result of his strike spoke for itself—he hit the monster in the side of its head with so much force he pierced right through its skull so deeply the edge of his pick emerged from its eye.
The beast whimpered weakly for a second before losing all strength in its body and crumbling to the ground lifelessly.
[You’ve slain Silverback Mauler (Level 5). You’ve gained 1100 XP.]

Kaiden finally allowed himself to relax, collapsing to the ground. His chest heaved from the intense exertion, and as soon as the immediate danger passed, his injuries hit him mercilessly. For a long time now, his body was fueled by nothing but adrenaline.

His ribs were most certainly fractured at best, if not outright broken. The initial attack of the beast hit him the worst. If Kaiden had bought a light armor instead of a medium one, he would’ve died—the metal chest plate he thought would prove to be more than enough for their first dungeon descent was in tatters.
"Kai!" Aria shouted worriedly before running up to him.

"Hold on, Kai!" Nyx did the same and started rummaging through his backpack. "Drink this!" she instructed while uncorking the low-tier health potion Luna had left behind with him. She took one of each while giving him the other half.

Nyx held the potion to his lips and gently tilted it so he could gulp down its contents with as little effort of his own as possible. "Aria, can you help by watching for threats? Beasts can jump at us from the bushes or even from treetops."
The Scarlet fangirl’s many hours spent fawning over awakened and their dungeon clears gave her some secondhand experience. Nyx knew that despite their victory, they were not out of danger—not at all.

"I’m okay... The potion is working... Thanks..." Kaiden grunted between pained wheezes. A low-tier potion was only helpful for light wounds, and its effects would materialize much slower than a high-tier potion’s would. It was still much better than nothing, though.
"I got 1100 XP..." Kaiden said with wonderment in his tone.
"900 here. It’s an amazing gain!" Nyx replied with a happy smile. If her boyfriend could think about his XP gains, then he was in a better condition than she assumed.
The amount of XP one gained depended on multiple factors. Firstly, the difference in levels. The bigger the gap between the slayer and the slain, the more rewards the slayer gets.

Secondly, the slain monster’s difficulty. Even if the rabid forest rats from before were level 5, they would not grant even a third of the XP they received from the silverback mauler simply because they were lesser life forms, an inferior species.

Lastly, the factor of XP sharing. If one fought in a team, their XP gains would be worse than if they fought alone. How much each teammate received depended on their input leading to the demise of the monster or slain awakened human. However, said input didn’t necessarily have to be damage dealt. Healing your allies, grabbing the monster’s attention at a critical moment, tanks protecting glass-canon attackers or fragile backliners against attacks, etc... could all factor into how the sharing of XP happened for parties.

All that is to say, this was a monumental victory for the three of them. The chat was also going crazy with excitement, though they had no time nor the intention to read any particular messages or even pay attention to the stream at all.

"We’re going to be discussing private matters for a minute or so. In the meantime, enjoy the replay of our fight," Kaiden said before swiftly finding the moment where the bear ambushed them and put that footage in place of the live one.
The reason why Kaiden paused the stream was that he was staring at something extraordinary.
[Free Attribute Points: 10]
This was not supposed to happen. His stats should automatically receive a boost to them once he leveled up. The allocation of points should be predetermined.

For example, a mage-type would receive the largest boost to their Mana and Magic stats. Mana increased both maximum capacity and regeneration speed, while Magic boosted spell output and made casting easier. These were the core stats for mages, which is why they received the most points in these areas.
Awakened humans weren’t supposed to have a say in the matter. It was theorized that the class type alone determined the path of one’s stat allocations.
A sudden system notification sounded in Kaiden’s mind.

[The Heavenly Demon despised nothing more than being told what to do. By the time he was capable of creating the system, he was already at an incredibly high level. Resetting one’s level was beyond even the means of the Heavenly Demon, making it too late for him to benefit from the ability to allocate his stats gained from leveling up. However, when reconstructing the system before his defeat, the Heavenly Demon incorporated this feature to grant his successor full autonomy, free from what he referred to as the ’Tyranny of the Universe.’]
’Damn... What a bro,’Kaiden thought inwardly. The more he learned about this mysterious entity, the more he liked him.

As for how much the 10 points he gained for reaching level 2 were? A lot. When one leveled up, the amount of stats they would gain depended on the path they took to level up. The stronger opponents one killed, the more stats they would be rewarded with. This was another reason why low-tier awakened were so disadvantaged against high-tiers.

A person like David with his mighty arcane arsenal could punch way above his own weight class while people like the gardener girl with the bubbly butt would struggle to defeat a monster that was below her in levels.

This was also why the ’dreamers’ were ridiculed. They were forced to farm monsters lower level than them due to the inefficiency of their classes, thus, they gained less stats than those who fought against monsters of the same level or above. The more levels they gained using this cowardly method, the more they fell behind the curve.
The dreamers often only received 2-3 stat points per level.
Normal awakened who fought against monsters of their own level gained about 5.

Thus, Kaiden starting with 10 gained stat points at level one was phenomenal news. It allowed him the chance to get ahead of the curve. The only question circling in his head was how he should allocate them.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Stat Mechanics
paragraphs: [Stats]
{Vitality: 11}
{Strength: 12}
{Agility: 11}
{Endurance: 12}
{Mana: 10}
{Magic: 10}

These were Kaiden’s current stats. He was a completely average man before he started his manic training regimen with Liam, so he was likely 10 in all stats a month ago. He couldn’t tell for certain, though, because as a non-awakened, he had no access to his stat window.

The changes the mana apocalypse introduced into the world were quite game-like, but one thing was vastly different from video games—people didn’t have HP bars. You died when you were killed, not when a magical HP number reached zero.

Vitality was paramount in making one more durable. It provided a flat resistance against all that was hostile. This stat made one’s skin more durable, strengthened their bones, gave them more poison resistance the more Vitality they had, etc. To summarize, the higher one’s Vitality was, the harder they were to kill.
Strength and Agility were self-explanatory. The former made you stronger, while the latter made you move and react faster.

Endurance boosted stamina. While it might seem to be the most useless stat of them all, it was one of the most important stats for melee awakened due to how big dungeon battles could become in higher-ranked dungeons and how much physical exertion it was on their bodies to fight against monsters with insane strength numbers.

Mana and Magic... The former allowed one to cast more spells, while the latter made their magic-oriented spells stronger and their casting easier. Kaiden’s [Doom Strike], for example, wouldn’t benefit from Magic even though it was a spell, as it was purely physical. The Strength stat made it hit harder, the Agility stat made it hit swifter.
Kaiden was a melee fighter for all intents and purposes—his sole fire spell was not enough of a guarantee for him to invest in his magical arsenal.

As such, he put two in each stat before giving his Agility and Strength the final two. Kaiden was simply too slow and weak in his fight against the Mauler. While Vitality would make him tankier, so would Agility in the sense that dodging was much better than tanking the hit and living to tell the tale.
Or so he thought.
[Stats]
{Vitality: 11 → 13}
{Strength: 12 → 15}
{Agility: 11 → 14}
{Endurance: 12 → 14}
{Mana: 10}
{Magic: 10}

The stats Kaiden gained were ’supernatural’ bonuses. He didn’t become more muscular as if he’d trained in the gym. His body was looking exactly as it did before leveling up. Only his basic stats—which could only be gained through painstaking effort—could influence his physical appearance.

This was why a high-level obese man could run faster than a bullet train, making for quite the comical scene. Even if he only had 3 basic Agility stats, his supernatural stats gained from leveling up would make him superhuman nonetheless.
"Are you girls also able to allocate your stats?"

"Yes, I put them in Mana and Magic. I was constantly running out of mana," Aria replied while not looking back at them even for a moment. She was diligently surveilling the surroundings as Nyx had asked her to.

"My Telekinesis spell isn’t mana-hungry; it depends on my mental fortitude more so than my mana reserves, so I put all my eggs into the basket called Magic. It should help me not only with control but with having more telekinetic power. I will not neglect other stats in the future, but first, I want to become strong enough to make good use of my one and only spell."
"Good," Kaiden nodded, happy with their choices. He didn’t want to instruct his Valkyries on how to spend their points, but he would be forced to step in if they invested foolishly.
"The stream is coming back right now. It’s also time we resume our pursuit of the cunt," Kaiden decreed before standing from his seated position.

"Where the hell is the association?! It’s been more than ten minutes easily!" Aria voiced her extreme dissatisfaction. A crazed lunatic assaulted them in the association’s dungeon, they should have been more hurried to correct their mistake, in her opinion.

"All we can do is continue the pursuit. I’m worried Theodore will get Luna killed when he runs into a strong monster. He is done for, but I won’t let Luna become a casualty of his psychotic episode or whatever this is."
"Are you sure he’s done for certain?" Aria asked; she wasn’t that well-versed in these matters.
Kaiden nodded. "If they can’t find him, the association will send in a monster like my mother who could sniff his hidey-hole out in a few minutes upon entering the dungeon."
Before Aria could reply, a voice sounded.
"Sup."
It was feminine and came from behind, deeper in the forest.
They all snapped their heads at the sound and had to blink multiple times.
Luna walked out from behind the forest foliage with a big grin adorning her lips.
"Wait, this must be a mimic!" Nyx shouted and aimed her dagger at the newcomer.

"You damned cowkin bitch, you watch too much Scarlet footage. We are in an F-rank, newbie-friendly dungeon and haven’t even ventured that far from the starting area. What mimics could be here? And before you say it, let me clarify that my goner of a brother is a swordsman; he can’t do such sorceries either."
Kaiden also knew and understood Nyx’s inhibitions, so he elected to make sure. As they say: better safe than sorry.
"What’s your favorite gaming playstyle?"
"Wait, not you too! Come on... Assassin," she sighed before revealing her answer.
"What’s my favorite meal?"
"You said you’re not a picky eater, but in my opinion, you like sushi and chicken a lot."
"Where did we meet?"
"In the toy shop.
"When was the first time we did anal?"
Luna’s eyes widened with bewilderment as she stomped her feet furiously on the ground. "We never did and never will! My poor butt would get obliterated by your...!!"
"Luna!" Kaiden shouted and parted his arms, knowing this was no mimic but his sassy Storm Valkyrie. Luna’s answers were more than satisfactory to ascertain the truth in his mind.
The purple-haired beauty similarly grinned before jumping right into his embrace. "Kai! I was so scared you would get yourself killed because of me..."
"What about me and Aria?" Nyx’s question was left unanswered.
Kaiden easily held her lithe frame in his arms. He didn’t feel like letting her go, not at all. "How did you escape?"

Luna giggled before revealing with a proud smile, "I waited for Theodore to be ambushed by a strong monster, and when it finally happened, I chomped down on his ear. He might have too much Vitality for me to punch him senseless, but this weak part of his body wasn’t resistant enough to withstand my bite force. I still have the fucker’s ear, look." She brought the aforementioned body part out of her pocket. Luna scoffed while looking at it. "I’ll feed it to the pigs when we get out of here."

"You’re taking your brother’s betrayal very well," Nyx voiced her observation with a surprised but joyous tone. A big weight had been lifted off their chests. Kaiden wasn’t the only one who feared for Luna’s safety.

"I lost my brother when he awakened, or more precisely, when he joined the Blood Pact. I’d been mourning him ever since. This was the final nail in the coffin which forced me to accept that he is no longer the person I once knew."
"I’m proud of you, Luna," Kaiden said while tightening his arms around her.
"Thanks!" she cheered before leaning in for a needy kiss.
They didn’t part their lips until they reached the edge of the forest.
"Enemies! Get ready!" Aria shouted as she walked in the back of the group, with Nyx taking over the frontliner duties to let the two emotional lovebirds have their happy reunion.

Numerous wolves bared their fangs at them from behind. These beasts had pitch-black fur and were nearly as tall as Luna. The pack presented a terrifying sight—twenty hungry wolf-like monsters bared their sharp fangs at them.
<Dire Wolf - Level 4>
<Dire Wolf - Level 3>
<Dire Wolf - Level 5>
Kaiden could only curse himself for losing focus while inside the dungeon. He was way too worried about Luna, so when they reunited, he lost touch with reality for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Dire Wolf Ambush
paragraphs: The monsters hid on the edge of the forest, waiting for Kaiden and co to emerge from the trees. After doing so, the pack sneaked behind them, blocking their path leading back to the forest.
None of them understood the reason behind the monsters’ strategy of not ambushing them in the forest, but neither did they have time to theorize.
*Awoooooooo!* the largest dire wolf who was level 6 howled. The rest of the pack immediately rushed at them, obeying the order of their leader.

"[Fiery Burst]!" Kaiden quickly put Luna down, grabbed his axe from his back, and used his free hand to burn a few wolves who were in the range of his spell. He received no kill notification—it was too weak to one-shot the monsters, but it did have a strong effect on them. The ones who were caught on fire started rolling on the ground to extinguish the flames, becoming non-threats for a bit.
Aria and Nyx also immediately started slinging their projectiles at the many beasts.

Nyx’s dagger was swimming in monster blood as she went from wolf to wolf, ambushing them with her dagger, which she smartly positioned above their heads so their eyes couldn’t keep track of it. Her heavy investment in Magic was immediately paying dividends. The blade was zooming through the air with a much greater speed than before—which meant its impact was fiercer than before her level-up. A single well-aimed strike from her was enough to incapacitate a target and even if they weren’t one-shot, she effectively crippled their fighting capability.

Meanwhile, Aria was showing a great understanding of her spell’s capabilities even though she barely had a chance to use it. She aimed it at just the right angle so that the crescent-shaped projectile slashed multiple wolves at once.
"[Stormblade]!"
*zzzt-CRACK!*
Luna intoned her spell, and it emerged with the same ominous force as it had before. A few dire wolves jumped back in fright from the sheer pressure her weapon emitted.

As to how the Storm Valkyrie could make use of her mana despite Theodore’s temporary mana-sealing syringe being injected into her system not long ago? Luna drank the poison-curing potion and thus expelled the effect of the serum.
She swung the blade at the brave monster who ignored the instincts screaming at it to avoid the menacing sword made of storm energies and was immediately torn apart.
"Oh, baby. I love this class of mine!" Luna whistled, finally able to use her [Stormblade].

Kaiden immediately understood her weapon was a lot mightier than his common-tier War Axe. It might even be straight-up rare-rarity, skipping over the uncommon category, which was between common and rare.

That being said, it made sense in his head. All his Valkyries should be equal in might according to the association’s artifact, but that didn’t mean their firepower should also be equal. Nyx had incredible utility with [Telekinesis], which would only blossom further as she gained more mastery over the spell.
Aria could sling her low-cooldown, long-range mage spell at enemies from a safe distance, giving her the benefit of range and safety.
All Luna had was a melee-ranged ability, so it had to make up for its lost utility with pure power.

*Awooooooooooo!!!!!!* Another mighty howl sounded from the alpha of the pack. As a result of its command, the previously frightened wolves immediately threw themselves into the fray while the pack leader was merely watching from behind.

"[Doom Strike]!" Kaiden brought his axe down on the beast closest to him and immediately felt the difference, thanks to his level-up. His Agility and Strength were boosted by more than 20%, which provided an easily noticeable difference.
[You’ve slain Dire Wolf (Level 4). You’ve gained 300 XP.]

The XP gain perfectly depicted how strong the silverback mauler was and how weak the rats were since they only gave 100 XP. These wolves were pack animals, while the mauler hunted alone. That being said, the size of the pack made them a much bigger threat than the single Silverback.
"Keep backing up! Maintain formation. Luna, only attack those that jump at you! Nyx, Aria, keep suppressing them with a constant spell barrage!" Kaiden shouted.

Despite this being the first time they ever fought together, their teamwork could already be considered to be pretty good. Partly because they understood each other’s personalities and because none of them were selfish. Many awakened teams fell apart because some members selfishly chased kills to gain more XP, ruining their team’s formation.
Kaiden and his girls didn’t do as such—they would much rather not get a shred of an experience point than have their cherished allies sustain an injury due to their bottomless greed.
*Awoooooooooooooooo!!!* A third howl marked the moment when the leader realized its pack was losing, forcing it to enter the fight.

Or that was what should’ve happened. In the leader’s head, the pack served the alpha. As such, they should’ve injured its enemies. All four of them were without injuries, thus, his pack had failed its leader. The level 6 dire wolf wanted to tear the humans apart once they got weakened from the pack, but that didn’t happen, so it elected to search for weaker prey.
Monsters could also level up, so some of the more cunning ones selected their fights after meticulous deliberation instead of charging blindly at every single enemy they saw.
"Don’t let them juicy XP packs run!" Luna shouted while throwing her sword at the retreating form of the wolves. Her sword dematerialized as soon as it was a few feet from her. "Fuck!"
Aria and Nyx had more success, and Kaiden also chased after the surviving monsters with his charge ability, which netted him two more kills.
*Clap! Clap! Clap!*
Loud clapping welcomed Kaiden when he returned to the girls. "Bravo."
A man congratulated them with a big, toothy grin. He was flanked by a team of five, each having such shiny and mighty fantasy gear they clearly didn’t belong in this beginner dungeon.
"Are you the reinforcements?" Kaiden asked.
"Yeppers."
"Levi the Whirlwind!" Nyx squealed excitedly as she immediately recognized the person standing in front of them.
Kaiden didn’t like his girl’s tone. "Hey, you’re allowed to fawn over Scarlet but not other men."

"Hehe! Sorry!" Nyx laughed and stopped before her possessive lover got the wrong message. She would be lying if she said she didn’t find this aspect of him endearing. In fact... The Space Valkyrie couldn’t help but squeal inwardly, ’He’sso adorable!’
"Why didn’t you help us?" Aria inquired with squinted, suspicious eyes.
"And steal the XP of such promising youngsters? I wouldn’t dare. You were on top of the situation, so we elected to observe and only act if required."
"What about Theodore, the kidnapper?" Luna asked.
"Another task force is on his tail. Our job is to escort you people to safety. Good job, kids. It’s over, you’re safe," Levi decreed in a reassuring tone.

Their first dungeon dive day had a lot more excitement than planned, but it had finally come to a close. Now it was time to see the capture of Theodore, after which they planned to at long last celebrate the many good things that happened to them in the past few days.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Little Sister Gone Rogue
paragraphs: ChronosX CEO office

"Hehehe! Amazing! In only a day, we gained over a hundred million dollars just from the media platform, while the cameras brought in five times as much already!" Maximilian exclaimed before puffing his cigar.
"This is just not the same. You’re ruining my smoke," the man scoffed while looking down at the woman kneeling between his legs. "Didn’t I tell you to paint your hair pink?"
Alexandra, the woman who grew up with Nyx and was her best friend during childhood, looked up at the man with lifeless eyes. "I did paint them pink."
Maximilian slammed his fist on his desk while shouting, "This is not the same shade as hers! You don’t even resemble her one bit!"
"... I’ll repaint them," Alexandra replied without a single shred of emotion in her voice.
"Just stand up and leave. You soured my mood already. Don’t you have a shooting in an hour anyways?"
"I do," she stated before rising to her feet and walking out of the office as instructed.
Just as she left the door, the hurried form of Maximilian’s right-hand man rushed by her.
"Sir, big trouble! The punk and his sluts have a more developed mana camera than we expected!"
Alexandra couldn’t help but have some life return to her soul. If there was trouble, that could only mean good things. If she could, she would burn this place down in a heartbeat.
The blonde girl who was forced to paint her hair pink leaned against the walls and perked her ears to hear the conversation.
"What do you mean?" Maximilian asked while pulling his pants up.
The secretary was panicking. "I-I-I don’t even know if it’s a mana camera! We couldn’t tell it beforehand, but we just confirmed the man doesn’t wear glasses, a headband, nothing!"

"... What do you mean?" the CEO was becoming more confused by the second. Their first-person cameras were crafted in the shape of glasses. After numerous investments and hours spent tinkering, the craftsmen of his company managed to create a mana camera that used the glasses to record what the wearer was seeing.

The issue with their product stemmed from the fact that the clarity of the recorded footage was bad. Furthermore, the glasses were heavy and ugly. ChronosX decided to use these glasses only for a few videos to market them. After that, they exclusively used their third-person camera products, their cutting-edge product that was revolutionizing the industry.

These cameras could record in incredibly high resolution, sharp detail, and true-to-life colors, making it no surprise that the company’s profits were shooting through the roof. They represented a groundbreaking leap in technology.

"They released footage where both the female and the male were recording! But nothing is covering their faces! His fight with the A-ranked loser was also uploaded, and he was wearing nothing there either, and they even streamed their dungeon dive!"
*Bang!* Maximilian hit the desk with much more force this time.

"That fucker not only stole my woman, he even dares to threaten my sales! Put an entire analytics team on them and research their method of recording! Now!" The secretary strongly flinched at his boss’s shout before he scurried to do as told.
For the first time in a long while, a giant grin threatened to erupt on Alexandra’s emotionless face.
Blood Pact hidden HQ
"Sir, one of our warehouses was destroyed a few minutes ago," Victor Thorne’s most trusted advisor, a woman called Olga, relayed.
"Hoh? Did the Fallen Angels finally muster enough nerve to bare their fangs at me?" he asked while grinning devilishly. Victor was ready to bash some skulls.
"No, sir. At least, I don’t think so. We obtained camera footage from one of the nearby buildings, and it seems to be the work of a sole perpetrator."

"Hmm... Did the Flame Monarch finally have enough of our little organization? She might also suspect us for being behind the president’s failed assassination," he mused once his first guess was firmly rejected.
"No, sir. The camera was blurry, so we can’t be certain, but it was a short female with black hair that ended in twintails."
Victor stroked his chin while trying to remember if there was a woman with such a description among his known enemies. "No one comes to mind."
"That’s because I’m almost certain it was Alice Ashborn," the woman revealed with a wry look.
"... Ashborn? I took special care not to step on that woman’s toes. Why would she send her daughter to my warehouse?"

"Sir, I don’t think she would send her 16-year-old daughter anywhere near such a place. Furthermore, Vespera tends to handle these matters using her own two hands," Olga replied while looking at her boss strangely. She sighed inwardly,’Of course this cruel man would assume sending such a young child into the midst of an extremely dangerous criminal organization would be a reasonable thing to do.’

"So you’re saying a teenager who should be busy fawning over boys and staring at herself in the mirror for 10 hours a day is vandalizing my property?" Viktor asked with a smirk that told Olga he found it amusing rather than infuriating.
"We don’t know what reason she had, sir."
"Alright. The losses were too small for me to take offense. What about the sudden surge of rumors on the forums accusing us of being the bad guys or whatever ridiculous nonsense?"

"We identified the source of the new rumors to come from a stream under the group name ’Valhalla’s Sinners.’ Theodore Aster, a B-tier recruit, was supposedly speaking badly of us in one of their small-scale streams. He is currently sitting in jail, by the way."
"Free him. I’ll have a little chat with the recruit. Did the streamer upload a video yet where this footage is present?"
"No, sir."
"Good. If they upload it, kill them. If not, then a small stream means nothing. Leave them alone."

Streams on the awakened media platform could only be viewed live, they would not be available for watching later. The streamer could decide to upload it as a video, either in full length or edited for a more exciting viewer experience. If the streamer of this specific stream uploaded a video of Theodore saying such stuff, many people could see it, but as it stood, only those who were present during the broadcast saw it.
"Yes, sir. Should I do something about the new A-tier recruit? His parents were calling his phone."
"He is undergoing initiation, it’ll take a while. Make sure the phone can’t be used to track us down."
"Naturally," Olga bowed and left.
"Cheers!" Four jovial shouts sounded in the private room of a bar.
"This is my first time drinking wine... and also my last. I can officially proclaim that I hate it," Luna announced after she was done grimacing from the taste of the beverage she drank.
"Are you okay?" Aria asked.
"Yeah... I spoke with the Gale guy-"
"Levi the Whirlwind," Nyx corrected.

"... Yes, him. He promised that Theodore would get the psychological help he needed. I can’t do anything for him besides looking into this Blood Pact organization, but we’re far too weak to do such a thing."
"Yeah..." Kaiden nodded with sadness. He wanted to do more for his girlfriend, but he also knew their limits.
"What’s next in store for us?" Aria asked while gently stroking his hand to let him know it was okay.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Next in Store
paragraphs: "If we were normal awakened, we would head back to the dungeons after getting some rest... but we’re not normal, are we?" Nyx asked with a coy smile.

Kaiden nodded, "Indeed. We not only gain strength by farming XP but also by ranking the system up. Furthermore, our classes are very limiting as they are. The next rank will see me gain an entirely new sin stance, and you ladies should be getting more spells. It’s smart to wait it out before going in for the next dungeon clear. We only need a few dozen fangirls to rank up, we should wait it out.

That being said, as you already know, adult films were meant to be a novelty for our content. If we keep filming porn we will rank up sooner, yes, but I believe we will limit our long-term potential since we will gather a fanbase that only follows us for that type of content. On the other hand, if we go too hard on dungeon clearing, we will become just another group of sweaty tryhards. I say it’s time we diverge from the paths paved by others and create our own. Doing so will also allow us to depend on the system less. We have to diversify—we have to film some variety content."
"Like Luna’s gaming?" Aria asked while blinking at her boyfriend multiple times.

Kaiden nodded. "Yes, but that can only be uploaded to the internet, so it doesn’t fit our current goal of getting big on the awakened media platform. I think we should shoot a cooking stream but with the special flair of us working with monster meat."

When a monster was killed inside the dungeons, it would dematerialize. However, if you brought it out alive, its corpse would remain. Naturally, a monster gourmet scene emerged as a result. Monster materials were in short supply, though, because you couldn’t just keep kidnapping monsters forever from the dungeons. If you killed one inside a dungeon, then another would spawn soon after, but monsters that were brought outside weren’t replaced, creating a scarcity of monster meat.
"Oh!" Nyx’s eyes immediately lit up with excitement. Her mind was already racing with bizarre dishes they could try. Roasted wyvern ribs? Spicy goblin stew?
Eating monster meat was a luxury she could only dream of up until today. With their earnings, it would be an expensive undertaking but not an impossible one.
"I love the sound of this!" Aria smiled brightly.

"What about the kitchen, though? We can’t cook in the dorm, there’s not even enough space for the four of us to stand next to each other, let alone film decent content." Luna brought up a very good question.
"Exactly. That’s why we should focus on moving first," Kaiden agreed.
"To which?" Nyx asked, referencing the two types of homes they looked at. One where only he, Nyx, and Luna could move in, and another one where Aria and her two siblings could also join them.
Kaiden didn’t reply; instead looked at Aria to observe her. It was not entirely beyond their means to afford a home where the kids could have their own rooms, but the question was, should they?

Aria swiftly shook her head. "No, I think it should be only you three. Until Damian accepts my profession, the mood at home will be worse if we are there. Lux is supportive, but I don’t know whether she truly understands what it entails that we do."
"Alright. We will settle that issue soon enough. I wanted to have a chat with your mother anyway."
"H-h-huh?!" Aria yelped in shock, not expecting Kaiden to say such a thing.
"Am I not allowed to?"
"N-no, it’s just I don’t know if that’s a good idea..."
"I can’t rest properly until I know what’s going on with that woman," Kaiden replied, after which Aria gulped but nodded her acceptance.

They continued their celebratory event late into the night. None of the four were heavy drinkers, so the alcohol quickly got to their heads. Their Vitality stats weren’t high enough to completely stave off the effects of intoxication, let alone prevent alcohol poisoning.

Kaiden also finished editing their first stream and uploaded it. He deliberately edited out whatever nonsense Theodore was spouting about the Blood Pact. He understood very well that should he upload it, he would become their enemy to take down because once an awakened died, their media platform would go dark—meaning their videos would become unavailable to view. As Luna’d said before, they were not ready to beef with almost anyone, let alone some secret evil organization.

Their dwindling numbers showcased that the sudden burst of fame his unexpected victory over the A-tier awakened David brought in had lost its momentum.

The assassination attempt on the president and the products of ChronosX hitting the markets were much bigger news. The former presented a possible WWIII scenario, so a lot of doomsday sayers were having a field day making the public panic. It was safe to say that they were making it mainstream. Their videos were easily sitting on hundreds of millions of views, if not more. The incredible advertising budget was paying dividends already, but they diligently kept their ad efforts up as well. Flyers, airplane-drawn banners, social media influencers, and many more methods were utilized to bring ChronosX into the limelight. They were very thorough.
Furthermore, while they did sell their mana cameras to the public, they asked for an arm and a leg in exchange.

Kaiden refused to give the scumbag behind the ChronosX company his money, even if he could afford it. Sadly, people weren’t in agreement with him on this point, as despite the price, the cameras were selling like hotcakes, earning the company an insane sum of money.

Their products were a giant leap in technological advancement. While they couldn’t replace the mana cameras of old which were found inside the dungeons because those were extremely durable and thus perfect to record superhuman fights, the captured footage of the ChronosX products was miles ahead if one were to record in ideal settings—namely, anywhere peaceful where no one tried to cause giant explosions all over the place.

*Plop* his shaft was freed from her mouth so that she could say her piece. "I just wanted to thank you for all that you’ve done for me..."

Nyx promptly received her morning meal, after which the sleeping beauty also parted her eyelids, and she was eager to get her fill as well.

It took an hour for them to get into the ride, which brought the trio to the housing agency that was advertising the apartment they were looking for. Aria remained at home with her siblings since it was the weekend and she wanted to spend the day with them.

The agency was located in a neat, modern, towering building where multiple companies rented office space. They rode the elevator and entered the indicated door without facing a single difficulty on the way.
"Kya!" a feminine squeal sounded when they stepped through. "L-Luna? What are you doing here?"

Kaiden examined the woman sitting behind the office desk and memories quickly started surfacing in his mind—namely, memories of this busty milf kneeling in front of his large rod while he snapped pictures of her.

"You could say that..." Luna replied while she instinctively reached for her belly where copious amounts of Kaiden’s fluids were in the middle of being digested.

Anna said before jumping to her feet and rushing out from behind the desk to hug Luna firmly, and she even gave Kaiden a congratulary hug, though she was much more reserved while interacting with him than with Luna. Buying so many toys from the girl made Anna consider Luna a true friend.
"And who is this fine young lady?" she asked as her eyes landed on Nyx, who was watching the proceedings with an amused gaze.
"Nice to meet you, I’m Nyx, Kaiden’s girlfriend," she announced with a coy smile while reaching her hand toward the milf for a handshake.
"H-h-huh?!" The woman’s eyes began darting between the three youngsters at breakneck speed. "W-w-wait, a love triangle?! No way!"
Anna was just as much of a sucker for drama and excitement as Kaiden had remembered.
"Let’s just leave it at that, shall we? Or do you want me to start inquiring how your new backdoor acquisition has been treating you?"

paragraphs: "Let’s just leave it at that, shall we? Or do you want me to start inquiring how your new backdoor acquisition has been treating you?" Luna grumbled, eliciting a loud, shocked yelp from Anna, who snapped her hands to her mouth. The purple-haired beauty’s threat worked wonders as Anna strolled back to her desk and slumped back into her chair, taking on a much more professional aura.

"I imagine you’re here to rent a home," Anna stated while gesturing at the chairs facing her desk. The trio seated themselves, and Kaiden responded, "Yep. We already found the ideal one. It’s this," he said while showing her his phone.

"Oh, a good choice for a young couple to start their life together. Er, I suppose not a young couple but a young harem," the woman corrected herself while sending an exploratory gaze toward Luna and then Nyx, doing her utmost to fish for more juicy details, letting Kaiden know she was truly starved for some good, old-fashioned drama.
Luna suddenly started coughing into her palms while eyeing Anna with meaningful eyes. "Cough! XL slimy anal beads! Cough!"
This was more than enough to stop the woman from prying further—her face went pale before she whimpered dejectedly, earning herself some snickers from Kaiden and an amusedly raised eyebrow from Nyx.
"Yes, that’s the one we were looking for," Luna confirmed once her ’coughing fit’ came to an end.
"I see! It’s still available. We can go there for a viewing right now if your schedule allows."
"What about this office?" Kaiden asked as he looked around, seeing no one to take over the mantle while Anna was gone.
"Oh, my deadbeat husband is sleeping on the toiletagain, I imagine..." she scoffed with a very strong edge to her tone.
"What did he do this time?" Luna asked.
"Wrong question, dear. You should ask what he didn’t do, which is getting erect for one second in the last 72 hours!"
"Damn... No wonder you frequented that toy shop."
"I know, right!" Anna nodded fervently as if she were a schoolgirl whining about her boring boyfriend. "I imagine..." she then murmured while glancing at Kaiden slyly, "You face no such issues."

"I would rather die than not satisfy my girls," Kaiden decreed confidently, earning himself a kiss on his cheeks from a purring Nyx and rosy features from Luna. The Storm Valkyrie suffered from a malfunctioning mouth filter and had little care for what others thought of her, but embracing being a girl in a harem was still a bit difficult to do in public, especially when her boyfriend revealed such intimate details as if they were nothing.

Hearing Kaiden’s declaration and seeing the reaction of the two girls cemented it in Anna’s head. "Oh!! This really is a harem in modern-day 21st-century America! In broad daylight! I can’t believe it!"
"Cough! One bead at a time, elevate your pleasure to never-before-seen levels! Cough!" Luna sang some advertisement slogan with a low, threatening voice as she once again eyed Anna with an icy glare.
The milf once again turned red before whimpering strongly. Once Anna got over it, she stood from her desk and kicked on a nearby door.
"H-huh?" a voice of a man who was very clearly awoken from his slumber gasped hazily.
"I’m taking prospective buyers for a viewing, so stop sleeping!"
"Y-y-yes, honey, leave it to me!" he shouted.
Anna sighed frustratedly once she heard toilet paper getting torn and groaning sounds coming from behind the doors.
"Come, youngsters, I’ll drive us there."
"You’ve got a good ride," Kaiden said when a neat-looking Merc*des welcomed his eyes.
"Thanks! I don’t really know nor care about these things, my husband bought it for me. He probably thought it would compensate for his total failure as a man. It didn’t."
Kaiden eyed the woman amusedly, she seemed to have a mouth-filter deficiency similar to Luna.
They got in the car, with Kaiden sitting next to Anna and the two girls occupying the seats in the back.
"The location is very close; it won’t take long to get there," Anna stated after pressing the ’on’ button, which resulted in the V8 engine coming alive with a mighty roar.
They chatted amicably for a bit, but then Kaiden asked a question. "Do you know about the awakened housing? Are you able to get your hands on a home from there?"
Anna’s eyelids fluttered wide open as her head snapped in his direction. "Wait, don’t tell me!"
"Yes, I’m an awakened," Kaiden nodded while gesturing for the woman to keep her eyes on the road.
Anna did just as so, after which she murmured, "... Are you jesting with this old woman? I’m not good at understanding Gen Z humor."
"I’m not."
"T-that’s big news! Luna, congrats on catching such a big fish!"
The girl in question didn’t respond.
"So?" Kaiden prodded for an answer.
"I’m sorry, but no. We’re too small-timers for that. You should search at a bigger agency."

Awakened obviously had unique housing needs, such as sturdy walls and furnishings. There was an awakened district in this city where only the awakened were allowed to live, however, the prices were extremely high. They easily asked for 500 Chronos for a month’s rent, and that was for the worst type of building, but in exchange, they offered high-tier and level guards patrolling the streets and apartment complexes around the clock.

Furthermore, due to the high concentration of awakened, those who managed to obtain a house there could use the opportunity to network. Moving there would allow Kaiden and co to have their home watched at all times so they could sleep peacefully, thus, Kaiden hoped to one day obtain the keys to a home in the awakened district.
The four of them quickly arrived at their destination. It was an apartment in a nice, modern-looking complex. They took the elevator to the fifth floor.
"$1,500 a month for this is not a bad deal at all!" Nyx said with a big, excited smile.

It had two bathrooms, a big kitchen, and three bedrooms. While they would sleep together in the same bed, it didn’t hurt to have separate rooms to place their belongings in, such as Luna’s room being the location where her gaming streams took place.
"I like it," the girl in question nodded.
"Like it? I love it! I can’t believe I’m about to move in with my boyfriend into such a nice home!" Nyx shouted joyously while grabbing his hand in both of hers.
"Ah, to be young again..." Anna whined while observing the trio.
"This is exactly what we were looking for," Kaiden said after carefully checking the place for pitfalls that the owner might be trying to hide.
"Great! You can move in as soon as we finalize the contract."
"Let’s do that then."
Just as so, Kaiden rented a nice apartment to truly start his home life with his lovers. They were all very eager to start living together in a proper house and not a student dorm.
With housing settled, it was time to start the monster chef cooking show—and what a banger it would be!

I’m not good at understanding Gen Z humor."
"I’m not."
"T-that’s big news!
Luna, congrats on catching such a big fish!"
The girl in question didn’t respond.
"So?" Kaiden prodded for an answer.
"I’m sorry, but no.
We’re too small-timers for that.
You should search at a bigger agency."
Awakened obviously had unique housing needs, such as sturdy walls and furnishings.
There was an awakened district in this city where only the awakened were allowed to live, however, the prices were extremely high.

They easily asked for 500 Chronos for a month’s rent, and that was for the worst type of building, but in exchange, they offered high-tier and level guards patrolling the streets and apartment complexes around the clock.
Furthermore, due to the high concentration of awakened, those who managed to obtain a house there could use the opportunity to network.
Moving there would allow Kaiden and co to have their home watched at all times so they could sleep peacefully, thus, Kaiden hoped to one day obtain the keys to a home in the awakened district.
The four of them quickly arrived at their destination.
It was an apartment in a nice, modern-looking complex.
They took the elevator to the fifth floor.
"$1,500 a month for this is not a bad deal at all!" Nyx said with a big, excited smile.
It had two bathrooms, a big kitchen, and three bedrooms.
While they would sleep together in the same bed, it didn’t hurt to have separate rooms to place their belongings in, such as Luna’s room being the location where her gaming streams took place.
"I like it," the girl in question nodded.
"Like it?
I love it!
I can’t believe I’m about to move in with my boyfriend into such a nice home!" Nyx shouted joyously while grabbing his hand in both of hers.
"Ah, to be young again..." Anna whined while observing the trio.
"This is exactly what we were looking for," Kaiden said after carefully checking the place for pitfalls that the owner might be trying to hide.
"Great!
You can move in as soon as we finalize the contract."
"Let’s do that then."
Just as so, Kaiden rented a nice apartment to truly start his home life with his lovers.
They were all very eager to start living together in a proper house and not a student dorm.
With housing settled, it was time to start the monster chef cooking show—and what a banger it would be!

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Monster Cooking Stream!
paragraphs: "Oh, this place is so nice!" Aria cheered when she arrived. It took Kaiden, Nyx, and Luna a few long hours to complete the moving of their belongings and then to set up the new apartment, at which point they invited Aria over.
"We’ll get an even nicer one later so that you can comfortably join us." Kaiden’s statement earned him a cheery smile from his Moon Valkyrie.
"Let’s go shop for materials!" Nyx shouted, with much anticipation for what was to come.

Sarah woke up at 11 AM with a lazy yawn. She was still unemployed, but her days became much more enjoyable now that she had discovered such an amazing group of people she could watch. The girl never expected that her tuning into a gaming stream would lead her down a rabbit hole of such giant proportions.

She just wanted to watch the Supreme Empress rage at her video games, but now she was so much more interested in what the group known as Valhalla’s Sinners would come up with next than Sarah ever thought possible.
And, truth be told, she might’ve just found her first celeb crush—at least, since she became an adult. Sarah would rather not detail her hormone-induced crushes in her teenage years.

She thought Kaiden was just a guy with handsome features when she first laid her eyes on him, but since then, he’d proven himself to be so much more than that. The way he stood up for his girls when they were called names still made Sarah squirm whenever she thought back to his furious gaze, his ominous words, and the complete obliteration he did against a much higher-tiered adversary.
Sarah was still mad about them not getting more recognition for that.

Anyhow. After the duel came his best porn video, so much better than the previous two. The difference was night and day. Sarah didn’t understand how they did it, but they made it so the girl had a PoV as well, which, of course, was Sarah’s choice of perspective to watch.

It instantly became her favorite adult video. The fact she knew Kaiden for more than being a simple adult actor played a big factor as well. His aforementioned heroics, as well as his laid-back, confident attitude during the gaming stream, made her interested in him as a whole, not just his looks.

After that came their dungeon stream, which almost made her heart jump out of her chest. It was so intense! The Supreme Empress got kidnapped by her evil brother! What’s more, her hero decided to risk his life and dashed after the kidnapper! The close battle with the ambushing bear-like monster that followed made Sarah think she would straight-up have a heart attack.

The fangirl turned in her bed and opened her media platform. Sarah didn’t look for her phone first thing in the morning anymore—while Valhalla’s Sinners posted to social media, it was obvious they wanted to grow their fanbase on the awakened platform, so she thought it would help Kaiden at least a tiny bit if she also checked their awakened page for any news instead of the normal internet page.
Her eyes fluttered wide open when a picture was posted of Kaiden eyeing the wares of a vendor, but the uniqueness of this photo came from the wares he was browsing! They were monster materials!
There was an added line of text on the picture itself and in the post as well: ’Monster Cooking Stream at 11:30 EST/GMT-5! You don’t wanna miss it!’

"Video gaming, porn, dungeon clearing, and now cooking?! Does Kaiden want to branch out into literally every single facet of the entertainment industry?!" Sarah squealed excitedly. She couldn’t miss this show.
To make the upcoming stream even more homely, the fangirl quickly went down to the snack bar, had her daily argument with her mother, and then got cozy in the warm embrace of her heavy blankets.

She had the privilege of being not only Luna’s chat moderator, but also of Valhalla’s Sinners after having another private chat with the gamer girl—Sadly not with Kaiden—so Sarah was very proud and she wanted to be there as soon as the stream went live so she could fight back against the obnoxious haters. Although most people were friendly, insults—mostly thrown at the three women by miserable men—did happen from time to time.
Sarah tuned in just in time. The stream went live as soon as she started eating a spoonful of her Nut*lla.

It was only one person’s PoV this time—Kaiden’s. He was looking at himself in the mirror, and Sarah couldn’t help but let a burst of surprised laughter escape her lips. "What the hell?! Hahaha! Kaiden!!!" She started slapping her plump thighs amusedly.
Sarah couldn’t believe her eyes. He was dressed like a professional Italian master chef!

A white-colored chef’s attire hugged his frame, with rolled-up sleeves revealing his veiny forearms. A neatly tied black apron hung from his waist, and on his head sat a chef’s giant hat—it was tilted a bit, giving him an air of playfulness. The getup was finished with tailored black trousers and polished shoes.
Due to the getup, Sarah couldn’t help but feel as though he could both conquer a dungeon and prepare a five-star meal with equal ease while looking very hot throughout.
"Alright, everyone. Today, you’re watching Master Chef Kaiden at work," he said smoothly as a playful smile was tugging at his lips, making Sarah’s heart skip a beat.
The chat messages were already rolling in. Sarah eyed a certain woman in particular who had the galls to name herself a rather obscene title.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Kyaa!! You’re so handsome! What are you cooking?
"Me? I’m not cooking anything," Kaiden revealed with a smug smirk. "The master chef only instructs his diligent little cooks."

Having said his piece, he stepped away from the mirror, and three frames became visible. Sarah involuntarily yelped when she recognized the Supreme Empress to be among them. Luna was squirming from head to toe as she rubbed her thighs together.

The chat immediately erupted into a wild frenzy of comments. Standing side by side, they were each outfitted in assistant attires that were definitely more provocative than a professional kitchen would allow. Each girl added their own unique flair to the dresses that matched their personalities.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Diligent Little Cooks
paragraphs: Nyx stood on the left. Her beautiful eyes glinted mischievously as she leaned forward just enough to give Kaiden a nice view of her extremely generous bosom.

She wore an audacious, cropped top that left her sexy midriff entirely exposed. A short, tight black skirt completed her look, showing off her deliciously thick thighs. She playfully twirled a spatula around herself with her telekinetic power, making it seem as if it were orbiting her like a loyal satellite ready to do her bidding at a moment’s notice.
Sarah already knew that this woman felt very little shame based on her turbo-submissive roleplay video, so she wasn’t surprised to see Nyx once again showing no signs of being embarrassed.

To the right of her stood Luna. Her outfit was the most modest of the three—it was a normal chef’s attire, but it somehow managed to amplify her cuteness to the next level. Her arms were crossed in front of her delicate chest while impatiently tapping and looking at Kaiden, waiting to get the ball rolling. Despite her irritation, there was a soft flush on her cheeks that betrayed how much she cared. Sarah couldn’t help but squeal; Luna’s adorableness levels were off the chart right now.

Aria stood in the center. She exuded her trademark cheery vibes, proving to be the perfect balance of the two girls on her sides. Not only was her mood perfectly balanced between the two, but so were her clothes. It wasn’t as modest as Luna’s but neither as daring as Nyx’s. She wore a white, sleeveless chef’s dress that showed some skin, just a tiny bit at the hips.

The form-fitting uniform highlighted her bomb of a feminine figure while the skirt part of it reached her knees, giving her a classic yet alluring look. Her apron decorated with drawings of flowers added the final touch to her getup, bringing out her sweet nature.
Sarah thought that this absolute supermodel of a woman would look good in literally anything. Even a sack would somehow radiate charm if Aria wore it.
"I must say, my assistants are looking quite sexy and adorable today," Kaiden remarked as he was busy observing every single detail of them.
- Kaiden’s Wife: "Damn... No woman can hope to put up a fight against Nyx..."
- TouchGrass: Lucky for you, you don’t have to fight her. You’re just a random fangirl who will never meet Kaiden, let alone be his love interest.
- Kaiden’s Wife: Mods, please ban this rude person.

- Lapdog of the Empress: Supreme Empress Luna is by far the cutest girl, as always! May she reign supreme forever and ever! And if the Handsome Emperor ever betrays her trust, I’ll always be here for her if she needs a broad shoulder to cry on!

- DeleteYuumi: Didn’t you say you can only bench 50? What broad shoulders? By the way, I was a Luna supremacist as well, but I’m switching to Aria supremacy. She is by far the prettiest girl I’ve ever laid my eyes on.
- Lapdog of the Empress: Heresy! Heresy! Heresy! Every single word coming from your mouth is nothing but shameless lies!
- DungeonDude89: Bruh, I accidentally misclicked. What the hell is going on here?
- Shadow Warrior: How do you misclick on the awakened platform? You ’click’ with your mind.
- DungeonDude89: Okay, the thumbnail might’ve grabbed my attention, and I couldn’t help but listen to my inner devil, I’ll admit!
"Let’s see how my lovely cooks will perform today," Kaiden decreed once he had enough of reading the chat.
"Chef, chef!" Nyx raised her right hand into the air and started jumping repeatedly, making her breasts bounce up and down with great velocity.

Since the stream was recorded by Kaiden’s [First-person Camera] skill, Sarah and all other viewers could observe his head move up and down in perfect sync with Nyx’s chest as if he were completely hypnotized.
Sarah couldn’t help but giggle. "Men!" Her laughter turned to a higher pitch when she focused on Luna’s dark features as she eyed Nyx with pure bloodlust oozing from her body.
"Yes, Assistant Nyx?" Kaiden managed to formulate the words at long last.
"I’m wondering what we might be cooking today!"
"Very good question, assistant! I like your eagerness, it’ll take you far in the world of monster cuisine."
"Thank you, Chef!"

"You’re welcome, especially if you keep asking your question in this exact manner. My answer is that we’ll be making a hot pot! Although I’m a perfect professional, my assistant cooks are beginners at the trade, so we’ll start with an easy recipe. I got it from the book published by Madame Spice!" Kaiden decreed before reaching for a book and opening it to a hotpot recipe.

Madame Spice was a best-selling author and one of the first people to specialize in monster cuisine. Over the past ten years, she earned herself a great deal of fame in the culinary world, becoming a true celebrity in this industry.
Sarah couldn’t help but giggle at the audacity of this shameless man.
- Princeless Princess: Kaiden, didn’t you just say you were a pro? Why are you using another chef’s recipe book?
"Hey, a professional is always looking for ways to improve!"
- Princeless Princess: Mhm. I see...
- Kaiden’s Wife: I believe you, Kai! I’m sure it’ll turn out amazing. Don’t let this rude woman ruin your mood.
A vein popped on Sarah’s forehead as she read the reply of this ugly tramp. Such a random simp had the gall to role-play as his online wife and even badmouth others.

She was debating banning this woman for a second but then realized that she was about to mod abuse, so the fangirl smartly refrained from doing so. Sarah couldn’t afford to lose her mod privileges for such an awesome channel.
Kaiden started walking towards the kitchen counter, where Sarah could see numerous ingredients already prepared.
"Everything is ready. Let’s start, shall we?"
"Yes, Chef!" A chorus of feminine voices welcomed his question as each of his assistants diligently obeyed the master chef—some with more eagerness than others.
